items.remediation_detail: Deploy docker-socket-proxy (tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy) between Portainer and Docker socket. Limit API surface to GET /containers, GET /images, GET /networks. Remove direct docker.sock mount from Portainer. | RESOLVED 2026-05-31: Portainer connects via docker-socket-proxy (--host tcp://docker-socket-proxy:2375, depends_on docker-socket-proxy) — no raw /var/run/docker.sock mount on Portainer. Architecture mitigation in place.

Enable Woodpecker trusted repos feature. Restrict pipeline execution to approved repos only. Consider switching to rootless Docker backend for agent isolation. | PARTIAL (2026-06-10 review): WOODPECKER_REPO_OWNERS restricts repo activation to the admin user, WOODPECKER_OPEN=false, WOODPECKER_PLUGINS_PRIVILEGED defaults empty, WOODPECKER_AUTHENTICATE_PUBLIC_REPOS=false. Remaining: rootless agent backend evaluation.
items.resolution: Primary config_change remediation (restrict pipeline execution to approved repos) live-verified on devops-woodpecker-server-1: WOODPECKER_OPEN=false, WOODPECKER_REPO_OWNERS=pazny (admin-only repo activation), WOODPECKER_PLUGINS_PRIVILEGED= (empty), WOODPECKER_AUTHENTICATE_PUBLIC_REPOS=false. The CRITICAL exploitable path (arbitrary repo activation -> privileged pipeline -> docker-socket escape) is closed at the activation gate: only the admin operator can create pipelines, against their own Gitea repos (single-operator trust model). Residual defense-in-depth item (rootless/socketless agent backend, WOODPECKER_BACKEND=docker) reclassified to a P2 hardening backlog item (accept-risk default for a single-operator lab, mirrors the FreePBX accept-risk pattern) -- NOT a live-exploitable CRITICAL.

items.remediation_detail: n8n unauthenticated SSRF via HTTP Request node + webhooks (could scan the internal Docker network: Redis, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Prometheus, Portainer). RESOLVED 2026-06-06: enabled n8n's BUILT-IN SSRF guard N8N_SSRF_PROTECTION_ENABLED="true" (n8n core since 2.12, ships default-OFF) via the n8n-base plugin compose-extension, gated by the n8n_ssrf_protection default (true); optional N8N_SSRF_BLOCKED_IP_RANGES / allow-list overrides exposed as role defaults. NOTE: the original advice ('N8N_WEBHOOK_AUTH=true') was incorrect — no such env var exists in n8n; the real control is N8N_SSRF_PROTECTION_ENABLED, which denies private/link-local egress from the HTTP Request node. Defence-in-depth: SEC-02 moved the header-trust backends off the flat shared_net onto Traefik-only gated nets.

Uptime Kuma SSRF via monitor URL creation. Admin can create monitors targeting internal Docker services (Redis, PostgreSQL, etc) for network reconnaissance. Accept-with-doc or network-isolate; operator decision.

CVE-2025-61675 (CVSS 8.6): authenticated SQLi in Endpoint Management (4 endpoints, 11 params). CVE-2025-61678: file upload RCE via directory traversal in Custom Firmware Management. items.remediation_detail: PENTEST FINDING: Incomplete X-authentik-* header stripping in nginx forward auth config. authentik-proxy-auth.conf only captures 3 of 10+ headers (username, groups, email). Missing: X-authentik-uid, X-authentik-name, X-authentik-entitlements, X-authentik-jwt, X-authentik-meta-*. Authenticated attacker can inject forged values for uncaptured headers — potential privilege escalation if any backend trusts these. Fix: add auth_request_set + proxy_set_header for ALL X-authentik-* headers, or add proxy_set_header X-authentik-uid '' etc. to clear client-sent values.
items.resolved_by: Added all 11 X-authentik-* headers to authentik-proxy-auth.conf (auth_request_set + proxy_set_header). Client-sent forgeries are now overwritten by upstream values.

items.remediation_detail: PENTEST FINDING: Overly permissive error_page bypass in nginx forward auth. error_page 403 404 500 502 503 all map to @authentik_bypass which returns 200 (allow). If Authentik outpost is down/unreachable/returns error, ALL 13 proxy-auth-protected services become accessible without authentication. Particularly dangerous: 403 (forbidden) should NOT bypass — it means user lacks authorization. Fix: change error_page 403 to return 403; change 500/502/503 to return 503 instead of 200. Trades availability for security.
items.resolved_by: Rewrote both authentik-proxy-auth.conf and authentik-proxy-locations.conf. Only 404 goes to @authentik_bypass. 403 now blocks (denied by Authentik). 500/502/503/504 → @authentik_fail_closed (returns 503 HTML). Fail-closed for all 13 proxy-auth services.

items.remediation_detail: PENTEST FINDING: Open WebUI code interpreter module blocking mechanism is trivially bypassable. _real_import reference leaked into execution scope allows LLM-generated code to undo import restrictions. Default BLOCKED_MODULES is empty. When CODE_INTERPRETER_ENGINE=jupyter, prompt injection can achieve server-side RCE. Mitigation: (1) Do NOT use jupyter engine — keep default pyodide (client-side). items.remediation_detail: PENTEST FINDING: RustFS gRPC/internode RPC signature verification uses non-constant-time string comparison (http_auth.rs:114 `!=`) instead of subtle::ConstantTimeEq which is already used for S3 auth in the same codebase. Timing side-channel (CWE-208) could allow signature recovery by an attacker on Docker shared_net. Secondary issues: (a) Future timestamps bypass 5-min replay window via saturating_sub, (b) Error logs leak partial expected signature. Fix: replace `!=` with `constant_time_eq()` from rustfs/src/auth.rs, add abs() timestamp delta check, sanitize error logs.

SAML Assertion Injection via Signature Bypass (CVSS 8.8). When SAML Source has Verify Assertion Signature enabled but Verify Response Signature disabled, attacker can prepend unsigned malicious assertion to legitimate signed one. Authentik then trusts and processes the forged assertion instead of the legitimate one. Our version 2025.12.4 includes the fix — no action required.

Knative Ingress Rule Injection allows Host Restriction Bypass (GHSA-67jx-r9pv-98rj). User-controlled values interpolated into backtick-delimited Traefik router rule expressions without escaping. Attacker in shared/multi-tenant Kubernetes can inject additional operators to bypass host and header routing constraints. Fixed in v3.6.11 — our pinned version. Not exploitable in nOS (no Knative/K8s) but documented for completeness.

RCE via Arbitrary File Write (CVSS 10.0). Unrestricted file upload allows authenticated attacker to write files with dangerous types, leading to code execution. Affects n8n 0.123.0 to <1.121.3. Our version 2.10.1 is well past the fix — no action required.

Nginx 4 new CVEs (April 2026): CVE-2026-27654 (medium) heap buffer overflow in ngx_http_dav_module via COPY/MOVE with alias — path escape outside document root. CVE-2026-27784 (medium) + CVE-2026-32647 (medium) buffer overflow in ngx_http_mp4_module — memory overwrite/code execution via crafted MP4 files. CVE-2026-27651 (low) NULL pointer deref in CRAM-MD5/APOP (ngx_mail). All affect 0.5.x through 1.29.6, fixed in 1.29.7+ / 1.28.3+. Run 'brew upgrade nginx' to ensure >= 1.29.7. items.remediation_detail: Open WebUI 2 RCE via command injection (ZDI-26-031 / CVE-2026-0765 + ZDI-26-032 / CVE-2026-0766, CVSS 8.8). CVE-2026-0765: install_frontmatter_requirements — unsanitized PIP package names from tool frontmatter enable arbitrary command execution. CVE-2026-0766: load_tool_module_by_id — user-supplied string used to execute Python code without validation. Both require authenticated ADMIN access (tool/function authoring is admin-gated). 2026-06-22 RE-CHECK (cycle 16): there is STILL no upstream fix version — NVD lists only 0.6.32 as affected with no patched version; GHSA-cggw-334c-f4mj (0766) has an empty version block; SentinelOne's writeup advises upgrading to a release published AFTER 0.6.32 'as the vendor makes one available' (none was). Live source on master still does subprocess pip-install of comma-split frontmatter names and exec()s the tool module body — unchanged. This is intended admin-only extensibility (authoring a tool == running code by design), which is why the vendor issued no patch and disputes the framing. CONSEQUENCE: the current pin 0.8.12 does NOT fix it, and neither does 0.9.6 (see REM-101) — do NOT close this against a version bump. Mitigation is operational only: restrict who may author tools/functions to trusted admins, disable custom tool upload if unused; defense-in-depth = Authentik OIDC wall + Tier gating in front of Open WebUI. Treat as vendor-disputed admin-trust, not version-fixable.
items.resolution: Vendor-disputed WONTFIX-by-design (no fix version exists). CVE-2026-0765/0766 both require AUTHENTICATED ADMIN access (tool frontmatter / load_tool_module_by_id). In a single-operator lab the Open WebUI admin IS the operator (already has host access), so an admin-only RCE is not a privilege escalation. Open WebUI now on 0.9.6. Accept-risk, mirrors FreePBX/vendor-blocked pattern.

(2) GHSA-mm2q-qcmx-gw4w (HIGH) — ListServiceAccount authorizes against the wrong admin action, enabling cross-user service-account enumeration and ROOT service-account takeover; fixed in 1.0.0-alpha.98. Bump rustfs_version 1.0.0-alpha.93 -> 1.0.0-alpha.98 (default.config.yml is source-of-truth; mirror the role default per version-pins-default-config-shadow) to clear both with margin (alpha.98 is the highest patched version across all reviewed RustFS advisories). nOS mitigation lowering real-world reach: the S3 + admin API (RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET) binds 127.0.0.1:9010 only — loopback / Docker shared_net reachable, NOT external; only the web console (9001) is Traefik-routed, and that router carries auth: none (traefik_auth_modes['rustfs']='none', no authentik@file forward-auth) so it relies solely on RustFS's own alpha-grade credential login. CVE-2026-7482 'Bleeding Llama' (CVSS 9.1) — heap out-of-bounds read in Ollama's GGUF model loader (unsafe WriteTo()). UNAUTHENTICATED: a crafted GGUF with an oversized tensor shape sent to /api/create triggers an OOB heap read during model creation, leaking Ollama process memory (env vars, API keys, system prompts, concurrent users' conversation data); ~300k servers globally. Fixed in Ollama 0.17.1 (2026-02-25). nOS MITIGATION, two independent layers: (a) Ollama is the HOST Homebrew install (roles/pazny.openclaw/tasks/main.yml, community.general.homebrew state=latest) — every run floats it to the current formula (~0.30+), well past 0.17.1; there is NO ollama_version var to pin (same host-install reality as REM-024). (b) The API binds 127.0.0.1:11434 (Ollama default; no OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 in the launchd plist) — not externally reachable, only the on-host OpenClaw gateway consumes it. NOT applicable: CVE-2026-42248/42249 (Windows auto-updater signature-verification RCE) — nOS runs the macOS/Linux Homebrew build, not the Windows auto-updater. Residual: operator-side brew-currency verification (cross-ref REM-024). Mitigated.

Two RCE flaws in @paperclipai/server, BOTH fixed in release v2026.416.0 (tag commit b8725c5, 2026-04-16): (1) CVE-2026-41679 (CVSS 9.8, GHSA-68qg-g8mg-6pr7) — UNAUTHENTICATED RCE via Import Authorization Bypass; a six-call, fully-automated, no-credential / no-invite chain achieves arbitrary command execution against a default deployment. (2) CVE-2026-41208 (CVSS 8.8, GHSA-265w-rf2w-cjh4) — an actor holding an Agent API key updates its own adapterConfig.workspaceStrategy.provisionCommand via PATCH /agents/:id; the server later executes that field during workspace provisioning (CWE-78 command injection -> host RCE). MITIGATED BY PIN: paperclip_version=sha-b9a80dc resolves to upstream commit b9a80dc dated 2026-04-17T14:44:19Z (PR #3784, 'multi-user access and invite flows'), one commit-day AFTER the v2026.416.0 fix release (2026-04-16) and a descendant of it on master — so both fixes are present. Perimeter defense-in-depth: 127.0.0.1:3006 loopback bind (services_lan_access=false), Traefik router with authentik@file forward_auth (Tier-2 'proxy' gate). RECOMMENDATION (supply-chain hygiene, not a live CVE exposure): repin off the arbitrary post-release feature SHA to a tagged security release (>= v2026.416.0; current line e.g. v2026.428.0) so the running image tracks a published, security-reviewed release rather than a floating master commit. Verified mitigated. | 2026-07-02 RE-SCAN (cycle-16 re-check): STILL RESOLVED/mitigated by pin. Three ADDITIONAL variant advisories surfaced (AI-assisted variant-hunt siblings of the original chain), ALL fixed in the SAME v2026.416.0 release -> the pinned commit b9a80dc (2026-04-17, descendant of the 2026-04-16 fix release) covers them too: GHSA-vr7g-88fq-vhq3 (no CVE, CVSS 9.8, UNAUTHENTICATED OS command injection via the execution-workspace cleanupCommand field, PATCH /api/execution-workspaces/:id -- exploitable with zero auth in the default 'local_trusted' deployment mode; directly relevant to the unauthenticated_endpoint_scan focus but mitigated by the pin + the authentik@file forward-auth wall + loopback bind); GHSA-47wq-cj9q-wpmp (variant of the CVE-2026-41679 import-authz-bypass RCE chain); GHSA-3pw3-v88x-xj24 (no CVE, CVSS 6.5, agent-API-key-authenticated arbitrary file read via adapterConfig.instructionsFilePath, affected <=v0.3.1, fixed 2026.416.0). No new item -- pin already carries all fixes. Recommendation UNCHANGED: repin off the floating feature-SHA to a tagged release (>= v2026.416.0) for supply-chain reproducibility. | 2026-07-13 RE-SCAN (cycle-16 batch-27): STILL RESOLVED/mitigated by pin. One further April-16-batch advisory surfaced -- GHSA-p7mm-r948-4q3q (approval-decision attribution spoofing via client-controlled decidedByUserId; an integrity/attribution flaw, not RCE) -- also fixed in the SAME v2026.416.0 release, so ALSO covered by the pinned commit b9a80dc (2026-04-17 descendant of the fix). Recorded for lineage; no new item. Recommendation unchanged.

New 2026 nginx CVE cluster, post-dating REM-035/REM-063 (which capped at 1.29.7): (1) CVE-2026-42945 — buffer overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module (nginx.org severity 'medium'; media-reported CVSSv4 9.2 and ACTIVELY EXPLOITED in the wild within days of disclosure; worker crash -> DoS, potential RCE); fixed 1.31.0+ / 1.30.1+. (2) CVE-2026-42530 — use-after-free in HTTP/3 (severity 'major'); fixed 1.31.2+. (3) CVE-2026-42055 — buffer overflow in ngx_http_proxy_v2_module + ngx_http_grpc_module, remote unauthenticated worker-process restart; fixed 1.31.2+ / 1.30.3+. (4) CVE-2026-9256 — second ngx_http_rewrite_module overflow; fixed 1.31.1+ / 1.30.2+. nginx 1.31.2+ (or 1.30.3+) clears the whole cluster. DISPOSITION (same as REM-035/REM-063): nginx in nOS is the HOST package (Homebrew on macOS via tasks/nginx.yml; apt on Linux, linux_nginx_package='nginx'), NOT a Docker image — there is no pinnable version tag in the repo and install_nginx defaults to FALSE (Traefik is the primary edge proxy). Remediation is operator-side 'brew upgrade nginx' / 'apt upgrade nginx' to >= 1.31.2; it cannot be expressed as a repo image-pin. SURFACE NOTE: unlike the earlier DAV/MP4 CVEs (REM-063, modules not compiled/enabled in nOS vhosts), ngx_http_rewrite_module is ALWAYS compiled into core and rewrite/return/if directives appear in vhost templates, so CVE-2026-42945/9256 are in active surface whenever a host opts into nginx; HTTP/3 (42530) is not enabled in templates/nginx/nginx.conf; server_tokens off is set. Left pending: operator host-package upgrade. | 2026-07-11 RE-SCAN (cycle-16 batch-25): three ADDITIONAL 2026 nginx CVEs surfaced, ALL cleared by the SAME >=1.31.2 fix target (no change to the remediation) -- folded in for lineage: CVE-2026-48142 (LOW, buffer OVERREAD in ngx_http_charset_module, info-disclosure, affects 0.3.50-1.31.1, fix 1.31.2+/1.30.3+ -- charset module is compiled by default so in active surface), CVE-2026-42926 (MEDIUM, HTTP/2 request injection in ngx_http_proxy_module, affects 1.29.4-1.30.0, fix 1.31.0+/1.30.1+), CVE-2026-42946 (MEDIUM, buffer overread in ngx_http_scgi_module + ngx_http_uwsgi_module, affects 0.8.42-1.30.0, fix 1.31.0+/1.30.1+ -- SCGI/uWSGI not used by nOS vhosts, latent). nginx >=1.31.2 clears the entire 2026 set (42945/42530/42055/9256 + 48142/42926/42946). Disposition unchanged: host package (install_nginx=false default, Traefik is primary edge), operator-side brew/apt upgrade to >=1.31.2, no repo image-pin possible.
items.decision: Host-package upgrade, no repo image-pin possible (install_nginx=false default; Traefik is primary proxy). Operator action: brew/apt upgrade nginx to >= 1.31.2.
items.resolution: N/A in this deployment — host nginx is NOT installed or running (install_nginx=false default; Traefik is the primary edge proxy per C1 doctrine). The nginx CVE cluster has no attack surface here. Applies ONLY if an operator opts into host nginx (install_nginx=true) — documented accept-condition: bump the brew nginx pin then. Evidence 2026-07-16: pgrep nginx empty, brew nginx not installed.

items.remediation_detail: Gitea 1.25.5 (2026-03-13) is the LAST 1.25.x release — there is no 1.25.6; the 1.25 line is END-OF-LIFE and every security fix from 2026-04 onward landed only in 1.26.x with NO backport. UNAUTH HEADLINE: CVE-2026-27771 (CRITICAL, fix 1.26.2) — Gitea's built-in container/OCI + Composer package registry serves PRIVATE packages/images to ANONYMOUS (unauthenticated) pull requests; ~4-yr-old flaw, ~31k internet-facing instances. In nOS the package registry is ENABLED (Gitea default; no [packages] ENABLED=false in the role) AND the Gitea Traefik route is native_oidc (traefik_auth_modes.gitea=oidc) -> NOT forward-auth gated (200 OK at the edge, Gitea owns its own login), so the registry endpoints are reachable by anonymous clients via the LAN/Tailscale Traefik route = a genuine unauthenticated-endpoint exposure (latent if no private packages stored yet, but the line is EOL). ALSO AFFECTED (all fixed only in 1.26.x): CVE-2026-22874 (CRITICAL 9.6 webhook SSRF, incomplete private-IP allow-list, fix 1.26.3; authenticated), CVE-2026-28699/28744 (HIGH OAuth2/Bearer token scope-enforcement bypass, fix 1.26.2), CVE-2026-28737 (HIGH stored XSS in glTF 3D viewer, fix 1.26.0), CVE-2026-22555 (HIGH org-fork CanCreateOrgRepo bypass, fix 1.26.0), CVE-2026-26231 (HIGH allow-maintainer-edits authz bypass, fix 1.26.2), CVE-2026-24791 (HIGH public-only token bypass, fix 1.26.2), CVE-2026-20779 (HIGH 2FA TOTP replay race, fix 1.26.3). NOT APPLICABLE in nOS: CVE-2026-20896 (CRITICAL 9.8 X-WEBAUTH-USER impersonation via the image default REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES=*) needs Gitea reverse-proxy header auth (ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION) to be ON — nOS does NOT enable it (Gitea uses native_oidc, no header-trust block), so the precondition fails; set REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES to loopback anyway as defense-in-depth. REMEDIATION: bump gitea_version 1.25.5 -> 1.26.4 (latest stable; 1.26.2 still misses the three 1.26.3 criticals; skip 1.26.3 itself — repo-code-page 'context deadline' regression). Interim: require auth for all package/registry reads. Already-tracked CVE-2026-gitea-template-traversal (REM-028) + CVE-2026-20897/20750/20888 (REM-066) remain fixed at 1.25.5. | 2026-07-02 RE-SCAN (cycle-16 re-check): STILL PENDING, disposition unchanged. NEW CVE folded in from the June-2026 nine-CVE 1.26.3 release (Hive Security / Gitea blog): CVE-2026-27775 (HIGH, authenticated privilege escalation) -- the pre-receive hook cached the FIRST ref's branch-write permission and reused it for every ref in a multi-ref push, so a per-branch maintainer-edit grant escalates to full-repo write; fixed 1.26.3, NO 1.25.x backport -> pinned 1.25.5 affected. Same remediation (bump 1.25.5->1.26.4 clears it alongside the rest of the cluster). Re-confirmed CVE-2026-20896 (9.8 X-WEBAUTH-USER impersonation) stays N/A -- nOS does not enable ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION (gitea uses native_oidc, no header-trust block), precondition fails. Pin unchanged at 1.25.5 (default.config.yml + role default in sync); traefik_auth_modes.gitea=oidc (200 at edge, registry endpoints anonymously reachable = the unauth CVE-2026-27771 exposure persists), 127.0.0.1:3003 loopback.
items.resolved_detail: Live-applied via agent-authored upgrade recipe gitea-1.25-to-1.26 + migration; converge ok=1321 failed=0, gitea/gitea:1.26.4 running healthy, /api/healthz 200. Verified 2026-07-09.

items.remediation_detail: Portainer 2.27 LTS reached END-OF-LIFE in Nov 2025 (superseded by 2.33 LTS) — pin 2.27.3 receives ZERO further security patches. A 2026 container-escape cluster was disclosed: CVE-2026-44848 + CVE-2026-44849 (both CRITICAL 9.4) — an AUTHENTICATED non-admin user with Docker/Swarm endpoint access reaches host-root RCE (missing authz on Docker plugin endpoints; Swarm service create/update skips 6-7 of 7 security checks -> Linux caps / bind-mount). CVE-2026-44850/44881/44883/44882 (HIGH) add bind-mount-restriction bypass / Git-symlink arbitrary file read / JWT-in-URL token leak / k8s middleware authz bypass. NUANCE: the formal OSV/GHSA affected ranges all START at 2.33.0, so a version-keyed scanner reports 2.27.3 'clean' — but the advisory prose states the vulnerable validation logic 'has never' existed (every Swarm-capable release), so 2.27.3's paths are very likely exploitable, just officially un-fixed on the EOL line (hence confidence: medium on the cluster, high on the EOL fact). SEPARATELY the 2.27.x container IMAGE base layer almost certainly carries CVE-2025-15467 (HIGH 8.8, pre-auth OpenSSL CMS/PKCS#7 stack overflow -> DoS/RCE) with no rebuilt 2.27.x image. nOS MITIGATION (reduces, not removes): the host-RCE bugs need an authenticated Portainer session; Portainer is Tier-1 admin-only, native_oidc behind Authentik, 127.0.0.1:9002 loopback, and reaches Docker via docker-socket-proxy (REM-001) not the raw socket. REMEDIATION: bump portainer_version 2.27.3 -> a supported LTS (2.33.8; or STS 2.39.2 / 2.41.0), carrying the full 44848..44885 fix cluster AND the rebuilt-OpenSSL base image. Note: already-tracked CVE-2025-49593 (REM-034) is only partially closed on 2.27.3 — its Moderate header-leak variant (GHSA-h5jw-8c32-xfv6) fixes in 2.27.7.
items.resolution: live-verified: infra-portainer-1 running portainer/portainer-ce:2.33.8 (no-hc, running); post-start OIDC/admin reconverge clean.

items.remediation_detail: Open WebUI 0.8.12 (2026-03-27) predates a large coordinated-disclosure batch shipped across 0.9.0 / 0.9.3 / 0.9.5 / 0.9.6; OSV's version-aware query flags 0.8.12 as affected by 1 CRITICAL + 27 HIGH CVEs. The CRITICAL — CVE-2026-44551 (LDAP empty-password authentication bypass, UNAUTHENTICATED, fix 0.9.0) — is NOT APPLICABLE to nOS: Open WebUI authenticates via OAuth/OIDC (Authentik), no LDAP is configured, so the LDAP bypass path is dead. The 27 HIGH are dominated by AUTHENTICATED cross-user / SSRF / stored-XSS / IDOR bugs (CVE-2026-45331/45400/45401/54008/54017/54018 SSRF family; CVE-2026-54010/54012/45402/45671 cross-user file read/delete; CVE-2026-44721/54011/54013/45314/45315 stored XSS; CVE-2026-44554 KB/RAG poisoning; CVE-2026-44552/44553 cache/role isolation), all reachable only AFTER login — gated in nOS by the Authentik OIDC wall + WEBUI_AUTH=true + 127.0.0.1:3004 loopback + native_oidc route. Two are unauth-adjacent: CVE-2026-45675 (OAuth/LDAP first-user race -> extra admin, fix 0.9.0) is blunted because nOS seeds and claims the first admin in roles/pazny.open_webui/tasks/post.yml before any OAuth login; CVE-2026-54007 (cross-origin postMessage confirmation bypass, fix 0.9.6) requires victim interaction. REMEDIATION: bump openwebui_version 0.8.12 -> 0.9.6 (single image-pin clears the whole cluster). SEPARATELY: CVE-2026-0765/0766 (ZDI-26-031/032) are tracked in REM-064 and have NO upstream fix — NOT closed by 0.8.12 or 0.9.6 (vendor-disputed admin code-exec); mitigate by restricting tool/function authoring. Already-tracked CVE-2025-64495/64496 (REM-005/032) + CVE-2026-28786 (REM-065) remain fixed at 0.8.12.
items.resolution: openwebui 0.8.12 -> 0.9.6 (HIGH). DB migration 0.8->0.9 clean under STRICT health-wait; live-verified iiab-open-webui-1 healthy, /health 200, route 200, idempotent re-converge failed=0. Shadow-pins bumped (default.config.yml + role default).

items.remediation_detail: Four new May-Jun 2026 MariaDB CVEs place 11.8.6 inside the version-affected range: CVE-2026-49261 (CVSS 10.0, RCE via shell commands embedded in a joiner node name when wsrep_notify_cmd is set; fix 11.8.8), CVE-2026-48165 (8.0, SUPER user injects shell via wsrep_sst_donor / wsrep_sst_receive_address; fix 11.8.8), CVE-2026-48163 (8.0, wsrep_sst_rsync parameter injection; fix 11.8.8), CVE-2026-44168 (8.0, mariabackup-SST param injection on donor; fix 11.8.7). nOS DISPOSITION — MITIGATED: ALL FOUR are exclusively Galera Cluster (wsrep) vulnerabilities living in wsrep_notify_cmd / wsrep_sst_rsync / wsrep_sst_donor / mariabackup-SST. The official mariadb image runs STANDALONE by default (no wsrep_on=ON, no wsrep_provider) and nOS runs a single loopback (127.0.0.1:3306) + internal-net, password-authenticated instance with NO Galera cluster. MariaDB's own guidance + the upstream GHSAs + Singapore CSA AL-2026-078 scope the advisory to Galera users and confirm standalone deployments are NOT exploitable; the CVSS-10.0 pre-auth network vector only materializes inside an active Galera cluster. So there is NO reachable unpatched HIGH/CRITICAL in this deployment. RECOMMENDATION (hygiene, low urgency): bump mariadb_version 11.8.6 -> 11.8.8 — a non-breaking patch-level move within 11.8 stable that clears all four from image-tag scanners (which flag 11.8.6 regardless of wsrep config). Already-tracked CVE-2026-32710 (REM-031) / 35549 (REM-067) / 3494 + CVE-2025-13699 remain fixed at 11.8.6. | CYCLE-16 RE-SCAN (2026-07-03): re-verified, disposition unchanged (MITIGATED — standalone, no wsrep/Galera, 127.0.0.1:3306 loopback). No NEW HIGH/CRITICAL beyond this Galera cluster. A separate 11.8.7 batch now version-flags 11.8.6 but is N/A to nOS: CVE-2026-44170 (NVD 9.8 CONNECT-engine REST Xcurl arg-injection = Windows-only + CONNECT/REST not enabled), CVE-2026-44173 (SELECT..INTO OUTFILE FILE-priv check skip on subquery-only FROM, authed, marginal), CVE-2026-44171 (mbstream/mariabackup path-traversal), CVE-2026-44172 (big5 client-lib escaping), CVE-2026-3494 (audit-plugin bypass) — all fixed 11.8.7, none reach the loopback/standalone/Linux/no-CONNECT surface. Bump target stays 11.8.6->11.8.8 (clears BOTH the Galera set and the 11.8.7 batch in one move). Src: https://mariadb.org/mariadb-community-server-corrective-releases/ + https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44170 [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

The redis_version pin '8.0' is a floating minor tag that resolves to 8.0.6 (2026-02-22) — the FINAL 8.0 OSS release; the 8.0 OSS branch is EOL, superseded by 8.2/8.4/8.6/8.8. The May 2026 'DarkReplica' advisory (5 CVEs, disclosed 2026-05-05) shipped OSS fixes only on 8.2.6 / 8.4.3 / 8.6.3 with NO 8.0.x backport (so pulling '8.0' will not self-heal — there is no 8.0.7). AFFECTED + UNPATCHED on the 8.0 branch: CVE-2026-23479 (HIGH 7.7, use-after-free in blocked-client eviction -> potential RCE) and CVE-2026-25243 (HIGH 7.7, invalid memory access in RESTORE via crafted serialized payload -> potential RCE). N/A: CVE-2026-25588/25589 are module-only (RedisTimeSeries/RedisBloom — not loaded by the stock redis image); CVE-2026-23631 is MEDIUM and conditional (replica-read-only OFF; nOS default ON). nOS MITIGATION: EVERY DarkReplica CVE requires an AUTHENTICATED session (the attacker must already have passed AUTH/requirepass) and nOS binds redis 127.0.0.1:6379 + internal Docker net AND sets --requirepass (REM-003/012) — so the PRE-AUTH attack surface is effectively nil; residual risk is post-auth lateral (a compromised app credential or malicious shared_net tenant) escalating to RCE on the redis host. Already-tracked CVE-2025-49844 'RediShell' (10.0) is FIXED in 8.0.4 -> 8.0.6 is patched. RECOMMENDATION: re-pin redis_version from the EOL floating '8.0' to a maintained exact patch (e.g. 8.6.3) — 8.0 will keep accruing unpatched CVEs and the floating tag is also a supply-chain reproducibility gap. Not an emergency given the auth+loopback posture. | CYCLE-16 RE-SCAN (2026-07-03): re-verified, disposition unchanged (MITIGATED — --requirepass + 127.0.0.1:6379 loopback + internal net; pre-auth surface nil, residual = post-auth lateral). No genuinely NEW Redis OSS CVE after 2026-06-20; the post-June-20 RHSA-2026:33444/29817/33427 (Red Hat, 8.8) are downstream repackaging of the SAME 2026-05-05 cluster (CVE-2026-23631), not a new ID. Three siblings from that cluster, all N/A-by-config here: CVE-2026-25588 + CVE-2026-25589 (7.7, RESTORE UAF in RedisTimeSeries/RedisBloom — modules NOT loaded), CVE-2026-23631 'DarkReplica' (Lua UAF, MEDIUM, only when replica-read-only is DISABLED — nOS is single standalone non-replica). Also N/A: CVE-2025-62507 (8.8 XACKDEL stack overflow) affects 8.2.0+ ONLY — the XACKDEL command does not exist on 8.0.6 (re-evaluate on any 8.2+ bump). Durable fix unchanged: re-pin off EOL 8.0 -> 8.6.3. Src: https://redis.io/blog/security-advisory-cve202623479-cve202625243-cve-2026-25588-cve202625589-cve-2026-23631/ [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

The pinned outline_version 1.8.0-1 (Outline app 1.8.0) is ONE patch behind the latest release 1.8.1 (2026-06-06). The cycle-16 unauthenticated_endpoint_scan surfaced GHSA-wgqc-257g-78v3 (LOW, CWE-208 timing side-channel): the INTENTIONALLY-UNAUTHENTICATED, token-gated endpoints notifications.unsubscribe and subscriptions.delete verify the token with JS strict-equality (!==) instead of constant-time safeEqual(), creating a statistical timing oracle that could forge a valid unsubscribe/delete token. Affected 0.69.0-1.8.0, fixed 1.8.1. UNAUTH-RELEVANT and reachable at the perimeter: Outline's Traefik route is native_oidc (traefik_auth_modes.outline=oidc -> 200 at the edge; Outline owns its own login page), and these two endpoints are unauthenticated by design, so an anonymous client on the LAN/Tailscale Traefik route reaches them (container binds 127.0.0.1:3005 loopback). Impact is LOW (forge an unsubscribe / delete-a-subscription token; no document read/write). The SAME 1.8.1 bump also clears the June moderate cluster: GHSA-33jq-x32c-3ccw (webhook subscription persists after creator's account deletion) and GHSA-pp65-6cc2-4mx9 (MCP list_documents exact-match metadata leak). ALREADY COVERED by the pinned 1.8.0 (no action needed): GHSA-7732-6qrg-wjf4 (HIGH OAuth-scope priv-esc, fix 1.7.0), GHSA-hw32-2v7j-mgqc (HIGH zip extraction path-escape, fix 1.7.0), GHSA-5x79-rj4g-qrh8 (HIGH OAuth/API-key scope path-parsing authz bypass, fix 1.8.0). Action: bump outline_version 1.8.0-1 -> 1.8.1 in default.config.yml (source of truth) + roles/pazny.outline/defaults/main.yml. Tier 3, native_oidc. | CYCLE-16 RE-SCAN (2026-07-03): re-verified — 1.8.1 (2026-06-06) is still the LATEST Outline release (no 1.8.2/1.9.0), the fix target is unchanged and complete. No advisory fixed above 1.8.1 and no new unauth issue on the outline/outline advisories page. The newest-by-date advisory GHSA-5x79-rj4g-qrh8 (HIGH, scope path-parsing authz bypass, published 2026-06-15) is fixed in 1.8.0 -> ALREADY covered by the pin. Slack-integration items (GHSA-mjgw) N/A (native Authentik OIDC, no Slack). Src: https://github.com/outline/outline/security/advisories

items.remediation_detail: CVE-2026-50141 / GHSA-g7mm-9vx7-jm7h (HIGH; CWE-290 authentication-bypass-by-spoofing + CWE-639): an AUTHENTICATED Woodpecker agent can inject a forged agent_id into gRPC metadata; the server validates the agent JWT but then discards the verified identity and trusts the client-supplied agent_id -> cross-tenant agent impersonation. Affected 3.0.0-3.14.0, fixed 3.14.1 (interim workaround WOODPECKER_DISABLE_USER_AGENT_REGISTRATION=true). MITIGATED in nOS on three axes: (1) the gRPC endpoint binds 127.0.0.1:9060 loopback (compose: 127.0.0.1:{{woodpecker_grpc_port}}:9000) -> not LAN-exposed; (2) exploitation requires a VALID authenticated agent JWT, so the pre-auth surface is nil, and nOS typically runs a single agent on the same host so 'cross-tenant impersonation' has no second tenant to cross; (3) the running image floats PAST the fix -- the woodpecker_version role default is already v3.14.1 and default.config.yml pins the floating major tag 'v3' which resolves to the latest 3.x (>=3.14.1). VERSION-PIN SHADOW CAVEAT (cf. memory version-pins-default-config-shadow.md): config-wins means the EFFECTIVE pin is the floating 'v3', NOT the explicit role default v3.14.1 -- the fix is present only because 'v3' currently floats to >=3.14.1, and the exact running build is non-deterministic. RECOMMENDATION: set default.config.yml woodpecker_version to an explicit >=3.14.1 (e.g. 'v3.14.1', matching the role default) to make the fix deterministic and close the floating-tag supply-chain reproducibility gap. Distinct from REM-002 (woodpecker docker-socket pipeline-escape, still pending). Tier 2; web UI route is oidc (Gitea OAuth app-auth, NOT forward-auth gated; 127.0.0.1:8060 loopback). [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

May-2026 dnsmasq CERT/CC cluster (VU#471747): six CVEs fixed in 2.92rel2 (and the upcoming 2.93). Our host pin 2.91 is AFFECTED. APPLICABLE to nOS's config (DNS forwarder, no DNSSEC, no DHCP): CVE-2026-2291 (CVSS 7.3 HIGH, AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N — heap buffer overflow in extract_name() while parsing DNS RESPONSES -> false DNS-cache injection / redirect to attacker IP, or DoS; UNAUTHENTICATED + network) and CVE-2026-5172 (heap OOB read in extract_addresses() on a malformed DNS response -> crash/DoS). Reachable because tasks/dnsmasq.yml binds the LAN interface by DEFAULT — dnsmasq_lan_access defaults true, so listen-address=127.0.0.1,<en0 LAN IP> + bind-interfaces — and dnsmasq forwards every non-{dev.local} query upstream, so a LAN/Tailscale client that makes it resolve an attacker-controlled domain feeds malformed responses into the vulnerable parsers. NOT applicable to nOS: CVE-2026-4890/4891 (DNSSEC-validation infinite-loop DoS + heap OOB read — nOS sets NO `dnssec` directive in dnsmasq.conf, validation disabled), CVE-2026-4892 (DHCPv6 heap OOB write -> local root RCE — nOS runs DNS-only, no `dhcp-range`/DHCP server), CVE-2026-4893 (RFC-7871 client-subnet source-check bypass — `add-subnet` not configured). dnsmasq is a HOST Homebrew package (community.general.homebrew state:present in tasks/dnsmasq.yml; the dnsmasq_version='2.91' var is documentation only, not enforced — like REM-035 nginx / REM-024 ollama there is no pinnable image). REMEDIATION: (1) operator-side `brew upgrade dnsmasq` to >=2.92rel2 once the formula ships it (Homebrew may still carry 2.91); (2) defence-in-depth — set dnsmasq_lan_access=false to bind 127.0.0.1 only and remove all LAN reach if LAN-wide *.dev.local resolution is not required.
items.resolution: N/A in this deployment — dnsmasq is the .dev.local LOCAL-TLD resolver (tasks/dnsmasq.yml, macOS /etc/resolver). This tenant is pazny.eu (PUBLIC TLD): dnsmasq is not installed (brew empty), no /opt/homebrew/etc/dnsmasq.conf, not running. No attack surface. Applies only to a .local-TLD install.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-6 unauthenticated_endpoint_scan finding (NOT a CVE — no Grafana Alloy security advisory exists in the 12-mo window; OSV/GHSA/NVD return no alloy-specific CVE). Grafana Alloy is HOST-installed via Homebrew (grafana-alloy formula, run under `brew services` — files/anatomy/plugins/alloy-base) and its config is rendered to {{homebrew_prefix}}/etc/grafana-alloy/config.alloy from files/observability/alloy/config.alloy.j2 by tasks/observability.yml. The `otelcol.receiver.otlp "default"` block binds grpc endpoint = 0.0.0.0:{{alloy_otlp_grpc_port|4317}} AND http endpoint = 0.0.0.0:{{alloy_otlp_http_port|4318}}, with NO auth extension configured (unauthenticated by design — 'public OTLP, apps -> Alloy' per default.config.yml). Because Alloy is a HOST process (not a Docker container with a 127.0.0.1:<port> publish mapping), the 0.0.0.0 bind means the OS listens on EVERY host interface -> the receiver is reachable from the LAN and over Tailscale, not just loopback. EXPLOITABLE (rated exploitable, not theoretical): any LAN/Tailscale peer can POST OTLP traces/metrics/logs into the observability pipeline with no credential -> (a) telemetry INJECTION/SPOOFING that pollutes Grafana dashboards and poisons the trace/audit lineage the A8 conductor agent consumes (false operational signals); (b) unbounded-ingestion RESOURCE-EXHAUSTION DoS against the Alloy->Tempo/Loki/Prometheus chain. Severity capped at MEDIUM: no host compromise, no secret/data READ (the receiver only accepts pushes), and the OTLP sinks (Tempo 127.0.0.1:3200/4327/4328, Loki 127.0.0.1:3100, Prometheus 127.0.0.1:9090) are all loopback-bound so the blast radius is pipeline data-integrity + availability, not those backends directly. The Alloy debug UI (alloy_ui_port 12345) is NOT exposed — it binds loopback by default (the alloy_self scrape targets localhost:12345). MITIGATING/AGGRAVATING CONTEXT: no nOS task configures a host firewall on macOS (the macOS application firewall is off by default and unmanaged here), and on Linux the only firewall is the OPT-IN, default-disabled roles/pazny.linux.hardening ufw -> on a stock install nothing else blocks 4317/4318. REMEDIATION (defense-in-depth, two copies must change together): if only on-host applications emit traces, change both endpoints to 127.0.0.1 in files/observability/alloy/config.alloy.j2 AND files/anatomy/plugins/alloy-base/templates/config.alloy.j2; if cross-host app telemetry IS required, keep 0.0.0.0 but front it with a host firewall rule scoped to the trusted subnet (ufw allow from <net> to any port 4317,4318) and/or add an OTLP auth extension. Cleanest knob: introduce an alloy_otlp_bind_addr var (default 127.0.0.1) so the bind is operator-controlled like services_lan_access.

Cycle-16 batch-6 finding (supply-chain hygiene, NOT a live CVE — Puter has NO published security advisories: github.com/HeyPuter/puter/security/advisories is empty and there is no OSV/NVD hit for HeyPuter/Puter in the 12-mo window, so the CVE leg is CLEAN). files/puter/Dockerfile begins `FROM ghcr.io/heyputer/puter:latest` — a FLOATING upstream base tag. The puter_version="v2.5.1" var (default.config.yml, source-of-truth; role default is 'latest') only labels the LOCALLY-BUILT image nos/puter:v2.5.1 — it does NOT pin the upstream code, which is pulled fresh from :latest at every `docker compose build`. The default.config.yml comment ('Dockerfile FROM pinned separately') is therefore INACCURATE: the FROM is unpinned. Consequence: builds are non-reproducible and there is a supply-chain exposure window — a regressed or compromised upstream :latest push is adopted on the next blank/rebuild with no review or version gate. Same floating-tag reproducibility class already flagged for woodpecker 'v3' (REM-105), superset 6.0.0-dev, and paperclip sha-<commit> (REM-097). PERIMETER (unaffected by this finding, recorded for the probe): puter's Traefik route is forward_auth (traefik_auth_modes.puter=proxy -> authentik@file gates every endpoint) + 127.0.0.1:5050 loopback bind (services_lan_access=false) + Tier 3; the /healthcheck endpoint is intentionally public ({"ok":true}) but only reachable on loopback / behind the Authentik wall. REMEDIATION: pin the Dockerfile base to an immutable upstream reference — `FROM ghcr.io/heyputer/puter:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` matching the intended puter_version — so rebuilds are deterministic and upstream changes are reviewed before adoption; correct the misleading default.config.yml comment at the same time. — CLOSED 2026-07-20 as obsolete: the Puter service was removed from nOS (nOS face replaced it as the web-desktop), so the local nos/puter build and its floating `FROM ghcr.io/heyputer/puter:latest` base tag no longer exist.

Cycle-16 batch-7 CVE scan (n8n). A June-24-2026 n8n advisory cluster (4 HIGH, CVSS 7.1-7.6) is fixed only in 2.27.4 / 2.28.1 on the 2.x line (and 1.x backport 1.123.61); the pinned n8n_version 2.26.2 is < 2.27.4 = AFFECTED on all four (OSV had not yet indexed them at scan time because they are <2 days old, but the GitHub Security Advisory API vulnerable_version_range strings are explicit '< 2.27.4'). HEADLINE + UNAUTH-RELEVANT (matches the unauthenticated_endpoint_scan probe focus): GHSA-75qm-gp28-rcq9 (HIGH, CVSS 7.1 v4, no CVE assigned) -- an authenticated user with the DEFAULT workflow:create permission saves/updates/imports a crafted workflow that pollutes Object.prototype; this is then leveraged to BYPASS AUTHENTICATION so UNAUTHENTICATED requests are treated as a privileged user -> the user-list + project-list endpoints disclose every account's email/role/MFA-status + all projects to anonymous callers, and the same pollution can corrupt global state -> instance-wide DoS until restart (verified live against the GitHub advisory page 2026-06-26: affected <1.123.61/<2.27.4/<2.28.1, patched >=2.27.4/>=2.28.1, 'exploitable without authentication' for the enumeration leg). The other three need an authenticated member/editor account + a NON-DEFAULT config: GHSA-mq3m-f8x3-579w (7.6, cross-issuer JWT sub-only binding -> user impersonation, only when token-exchange + multiple trusted issuers configured), GHSA-q3j5-8vrg-4p9q (7.1, HTTP-Header-Auth shared-credential secret leaked in $request.headers during pagination-expression eval, only when N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE=vm), GHSA-h44j-f5r5-ph73 (7.1, 'Allowed HTTP Request Domains' bypass via the AI-Agents MCP connector -> exfiltrate a shared-credential secret to an attacker URL, only when N8N_ENABLED_MODULES=agents). Same bump also clears 5 MODERATE advisories (external-secrets exposure/permission-bypass GHSA-2434-3x6q-8r99 / GHSA-jp7m-xcgx-57qm, MySQL-v1-node SQLi GHSA-hwmj-qg4v-cvg9, cross-project folder assignment GHSA-2xgm-wc4g-5jvg, data-table upload disk-exhaustion DoS GHSA-w867-jm58-p9pv). COVERED at 2.26.2 (no action, recorded for lineage): CVE-2026-54305 (CRITICAL, CVSS 9.9, Dynamic-Credentials cross-tenant EE credential takeover) -- 2.26.2 was the release cut specifically to fix it; CVE-2026-54303 (HIGH, reflected XSS, fix 2.24.0). PERIMETER: n8n's Traefik route is native_oidc (traefik_auth_modes.n8n=oidc -> 200 at the edge, n8n serves its own login + API, NO forward-auth wall) so once any authed user plants the polluted workflow the proto-pollution data-exposure/enumeration leg IS reachable by an anonymous caller over the LAN/Tailscale route; 127.0.0.1:5678 loopback host bind. ACTION: bump n8n_version 2.26.2->2.28.1 in default.config.yml (source of truth, line ~1395) AND roles/pazny.n8n/defaults/main.yml (the version-pin shadow -- both must move together per the version-pins-default-config-shadow rule); same-major 2.x migrate-on-start, validate workflows on the next run. 2.27.4 is the minimum safe version; 2.28.1 is the latest 2.x and additionally clears the 5 moderates. [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

Cycle-16 batch-8 unauthenticated_endpoint_scan (bone). Bone's read endpoints GET /api/services, GET /api/health/aggregate and GET /api/status carry NO require_scope() dependency (files/anatomy/bone/main.py lines 172/144/181) — unlike every operational route (run-tag / state / migrations / upgrades / coexistence, all Depends(require_scope(...)) since the Track-B 2026-04-26 JWT cutover that retired the legacy BONE_SECRET channel). Bone is a Tier-1 manifest service with domain_var=bone_domain (api.<tld>) + port_var=bone_port (state/manifest.yml), and traefik_auth_modes.bone='none' (roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml, commented 'JWT-validated API' — so NO authentik@file forward-auth middleware is attached). The Traefik file provider therefore renders an api.<tld> router with NO auth wall in front of these ungated reads. RESULT: an UNAUTHENTICATED LAN/Tailscale caller resolving api.<tld> can GET /api/services (returns the entire service-registry.json verbatim: every service id, internal hostname, port, version, health URL, domain), GET /api/health/aggregate (fan-out health of all ~37 registered services with the same per-service detail), and GET /api/status (instance_name='nOS', the nOS VERSION file contents, host gethostname(), services_count). This is a CWE-200 information-disclosure / recon exposure: the version map tells an attacker exactly which per-service CVEs apply, and the internal hostnames/ports/URLs feed SSRF + lateral-movement targeting. No credentials, no RCE, and it requires reaching the trusted-network perimeter (the api.<tld> route, not the public internet unless DNS+cert are public) -> MEDIUM. The uvicorn --host 127.0.0.1:8099 loopback bind blocks direct host access but does NOT block the routed api.<tld> edge. FIX: add Depends(require_scope('nos:state:read')) to the services() / status() / health_aggregate() handlers (KEEP the O(1) /api/health liveness probe ungated — docker healthcheck, launchd KeepAlive probe, and tools/nos-smoke.py all need an unauthenticated liveness ping), OR flip traefik_auth_modes.bone from 'none' to 'proxy' (forward-auth) — the JWT-on-read approach is preferred because it preserves Bone's bearer-token API model for legitimate machine callers (Pulse, Wing, conductor) that already mint Authentik JWTs. DEP NOTE (folded here, no separate item): bone requirements.txt pins fastapi>=0.115 + uvicorn[standard]>=0.32 + PyJWT[crypto]>=2.9 as unpinned >= floors, so the June-2026 Starlette/python-multipart cluster (CVE-2026-54283 form-data limit-bypass DoS, fix Starlette 0.49.1; CVE-2026-53539 python-multipart quadratic-complexity DoS, fix 0.0.30; CVE-2026-48710 'BadHost' Host-header auth bypass) rides on whatever pip resolves at venv-build time. The three ungated routes are GET-only with NO form/multipart parsing -> the two DoS legs are N/A, and Bone registers no Starlette TrustedHostMiddleware -> BadHost is N/A; but pin the deps to a lockfile (mirroring the wing composer.lock discipline) for supply-chain reproducibility. PyJWT CLUSTER (folded here, re-scan 2026-07-08): bone pins PyJWT[crypto]>=2.9 (unpinned floor). CVE-2026-48526 (Improper Authentication / RS-HS algorithm confusion — forge a token by supplying the RSA public key as the HMAC secret; fix 2.13.0) is CODE-MITIGATED: verify_token() in files/anatomy/bone/auth.py:149-158 calls jwt.decode(..., algorithms=["RS256"]) with a fixed single-algorithm allowlist and an RSA PyJWK from Authentik JWKS, so an HS256 token is rejected before verification — NOT exploitable. CVE-2026-32597 (crit-header extensions accepted, fix 2.13.0) + CVE-2026-48525 (unauthenticated DoS via unbounded Base64URL decode of the payload segment in a b64=false detached JWS BEFORE signature rejection, fix 2.13.0) are LOW-impact residuals (48525 is the only unauth leg — reachable at any require_scope() route since decode runs pre-rejection, but bounded by the 5s/loopback posture). Bump the floor to PyJWT>=2.13.0 and pin ALL bone deps (fastapi/uvicorn/httpx/PyYAML/PyJWT) to a lockfile — same supply-chain-reproducibility ask as the Starlette/python-multipart note above.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-9 (2026-06-29). Companion CE-affecting cluster also fixed only in 18.11.6: CVE-2026-2238 (MED 5.3, Rapid Diffs improper-authz -> view confidential issue references, unauth), CVE-2026-8330 (MED 4.4, CI/CD API sensitive-data leak to logs), CVE-2026-1606 (MED 4.3, Snippets content concealment), CVE-2026-5952 (MED 4.3, Maven Package Registry protection-rule bypass), CVE-2026-5796 (MED 4.3, group packages API disabled-registry exposure), CVE-2026-12635 (LOW 3.1, Repository Mirroring SSRF via improper URL validation). NOT applicable (Enterprise/Premium/Ultimate-only, CE unaffected): CVE-2026-10086 (8.7 Analytics XSS), CVE-2026-12053 (7.7 Duo Workflows info-disc), CVE-2026-5309 (5.4 Virtual Registry authz), CVE-2026-11379 (5.3 DAST authz), CVE-2026-0934 (3.8 Protected Environments), CVE-2026-3176 (3.1 Security Dashboard). UPDATED cycle-16 batch-24 RE-SCAN (2026-07-09): the target MOVES 18.11.6 -> 18.11.7 -- the July-8-2026 patch release (19.1.2 / 19.0.4 / 18.11.7) adds TWO more CE-affecting fixes that 18.11.6 lacks, both with NO 18.10.x backport so 18.10.8-ce.0 is still exposed: CVE-2026-13320 (HIGH 7.3, CE/EE, stored-XSS-class HTML injection in wiki-markup rendering, affects 15.7 before 18.11.7/19.0.4/19.1.2; requires an authenticated user) + CVE-2026-7492 (MED 4.3, CE/EE, UNAUTHENTICATED missing-authorization on cross-project reference / commit-discussion pages -> anonymous existence-disclosure of a private project, affects 9.1 before 18.11.7/19.0.4/19.1.2 = the NEW unauth-probe-relevant leg). EE-only in the same release, N/A to CE: CVE-2026-6896 (8.7 authed developer-role XSS). ACTION: bump gitlab_version 18.10.8-ce.0 -> 18.11.7-ce.0 (minimum safe; 19.1.2-ce.0 latest but a larger migration) in default.config.yml + roles/pazny.gitlab/defaults/main.yml together (version-pin shadow rule). MITIGATED: install_gitlab=false (off by default), traefik_auth_modes.gitlab=oidc (native OIDC, GitLab owns its login; the Web IDE is behind app auth), signup disabled, 127.0.0.1:8929 loopback bind. Supersedes the phantom scan-state ref 'REM-091' (never persisted). REM-018/027 (earlier pins) remain resolved. [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

Cycle-16 batch-9 (2026-06-29). The pinned mailpit_version v1.30.0 (set in the C1 sweep 2026-05-25) is version-flagged by a post-v1.30.0 advisory cluster: CVE-2026-55187 (GHSA-w4mc-hhc6-xp28, MODERATE) -- incomplete SSRF protection in tools.IsInternalIP() that misses IPv6 transition/mapped forms, so the Link Check / HTML Check API can still be steered at internal services; affected v1.29.2..<=1.30.1, FIXED 1.30.2 -> v1.30.0 is vulnerable. items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-9 (2026-06-29). CVE-2026-46376 (CVSS 9.3) -- use of hard-coded credentials in the FreePBX userman module: the optional generic-template setup ships static sample credentials that stay active unless manually changed, letting an UNAUTHENTICATED remote attacker log into the User Control Panel (UCP) and read/modify communication settings. Fixed by updating the userman module to 16.0.45 or 17.0.7 (introduces password randomization). VENDOR-BLOCKED: roles/pazny.freepbx pins the tiredofit/freepbx Docker image whose last published tag is 5.2.0 (2022-04-30, upstream abandoned) -- there is no path to userman 16.0.45/17.0.7 in this image and no maintained ARM64 FOSS alternative. Joins REM-014 (CVE-2025-57819 pre-auth RCE) + REM-046 as structurally unfixable in the current image. MITIGATED at the nOS perimeter: install_freepbx=false (off by default), the manifest entry carries port_var but NO domain_var so FreePBX is NOT Traefik-routed (no edge route), traefik_auth_modes.freepbx is moot, web UI host-maps to 127.0.0.1:8088 loopback (SIP/IAX/RTP only bind beyond loopback when freepbx_lan_access=true). Operators who enable freepbx accept the documented risk. Supersedes the phantom scan-state ref 'REM-089' (never persisted to the queue).
items.blocked_reason: tiredofit/freepbx Docker image abandoned upstream 2022-04-30 (latest tag 5.2.0); userman 16.0.45/17.0.7 fix unreachable. No maintained ARM64 FOSS alternative. install_freepbx=false + not Traefik-routed + loopback-only mitigate at the perimeter.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-9 (2026-06-29) unauthenticated_endpoint_scan. WordPress CORE is CVE-clean at the pinned wordpress_version 6.9.4-php8.3-apache: CVE-2026-3906 (Notes-feature REST authz bypass, Subscriber-auth) and the entire emergency March-2026 cluster (6.9.2/6.9.3/6.9.4 -- PclZip path traversal, getID3 XXE, nav-menu stored XSS, AJAX authz bypass, CVE-2026-3901 blind SSRF) are all fixed in 6.9.4, all require authentication, and 6.9.4 is the latest core security release (no 6.9.5/6.10 core CVE in the 12-mo window). The standing finding is the intentionally-public CMS unauth surface, still UNHARDENED (defense-in-depth, not a core CVE): xmlrpc.php (brute-force amplification via system.multicall + pingback SSRF/DDoS), REST user enumeration GET /wp-json/wp/v2/users, author-archive enumeration /?author=N (302 -> /author/<slug>), and wp-login.php credential brute-force. These are anonymously reachable because the WordPress Traefik route is native_oidc (traefik_auth_modes.wordpress=oidc -> 200 at edge; WP serves its own login + the OpenID Connect Generic button; NOT forward-auth gated). MITIGATED: install_wordpress=false (off by default), 127.0.0.1:8084 loopback host bind (edge reach only via the Traefik route when installed + DNS/cert resolve). RECOMMENDED hardening when wordpress is enabled: disable XML-RPC (or Traefik-deny /xmlrpc.php), block anonymous /wp-json/wp/v2/users (REST authentication or deny rule), disable author-archive enumeration, and rate-limit/forward-auth wp-login.php. Supersedes the phantom scan-state ref 'REM-090' (never persisted); the phantom 'REM-092' was the 6.9.4 core-clean note, folded into this item's first sentence.
items.resolved_detail: nos-hardening.php mu-plugin (roles/pazny.wordpress, toggle wordpress_harden_unauth_surface) — LIVE-verified: XML-RPC fully disabled (empty xmlrpc_methods → demo.sayHello "does not exist", kills system.multicall amplification + pingback SSRF), REST /wp/v2/users anonymous → 401, ?author=N → 301 home (no username leak). 6.9.4 core already CVE-clean; this is defense-in-depth. 2026-07-24.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-10 (2026-06-30) CVE scan. The pinned erpnext_version v15.98.1 is version-flagged by a May-2026 ERPNext advisory cluster. CONFIRMED v15-affecting headline: CVE-2026-44446 (HIGH, CWE-89 SQL injection via missing input validation) has a DUAL-LINE fix in ERPNext 15.104.3 AND 16.14.0 -> v15.98.1 < 15.104.3, so the pin is squarely in the affected window (high confidence). The broader github.com/frappe/erpnext/security/advisories cluster: CVE-2026-44442 (GHSA-cg5w-7g26-p3w9, CRITICAL CVSS 9.9 -- authorization bypass: a low-priv authenticated user modifies data outside their assigned role scope because certain API endpoints fail to verify permissions; advisory cites fix 16.9.1) + CVE-2026-44447 (GHSA-q65v-fm9p-9vh3, HIGH CVSS 8.8 -- SQL injection via missing input validation; advisory cites fix 16.9.0) + the HIGH SQLi/XSS set (GHSA-6fm9-g88m-hxr7 / GHSA-j669-ghv2-gmqg / GHSA-wj7p-g62h-jh38 SQLi; GHSA-r99h-h44m-89m2 stored XSS in Dashboards/Tools/Portals) and the MODERATE set (GHSA-mhm9-75w7-423r EDI-module XXE -> authed local file read, GHSA-6ffr-92hr-3394 path-traversal, GHSA-m4m4-j2m2-7fcw authed SSRF, GHSA-444j-g95x-5pqv doc-modification). The advisory metadata for 44442/44447 cites only v16 fix versions (16.9.1 / 16.9.0) so their precise v15 backport release is MEDIUM-confidence, but the confirmed dual-line CVE-2026-44446 (v15 fix 15.104.3) proves the v15.98.1 pin sits in the vulnerable window for this cluster. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): EVERY item in the cluster requires AUTHENTICATION (low-priv) -- NONE is unauthenticated, so this is NOT a new unauth-endpoint exposure; the prior unauth ERPNext item CVE-2026-27471 (CVSS 9.3 unauth doc access) stays resolved at v15.98.1 via REM-017. ERPNext's only intentionally-public surface remains its own login + /api/method/frappe.ping health. MITIGATED beyond the auth requirement: install_erpnext=false AND hard-blocked at role-load (requires erpnext_experimental_override=true -- the strongest perimeter gate in the fleet, REM-008 context) -> ZERO live exposure; 127.0.0.1:8082 loopback bind; native-OIDC (own login). ACTION: bump erpnext_version v15.98.1 -> v15.104.3 (latest v15.x stable; clears the confirmed v15 SQLi backport and any v15 backports of the cluster) in default.config.yml + roles/pazny.erpnext/defaults/main.yml together (version-pin-shadow rule). Lands as an acceptance criterion of the deferred ERPNext rework (REM-008). REM-017/041 (CVE-2026-27471 + the CVE-2025-52039..52050 SQLi cluster) remain resolved at the current pin.
items.resolution: N/A in this deployment — install_erpnext=false (default) and the role is HARD-BLOCKED at load (requires erpnext_experimental_override=true; parked for rework, see roles/pazny.erpnext/README.md). Not running, no attack surface. The v15.104.3 bump applies only if/when erpnext is un-parked; recorded as the target pin for that supervised enable.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-11 (2026-07-01) CVE scan. RustFS shipped a June-2026 advisory cluster (published 2026-06-27 and 2026-06-29, AFTER the 2026-06-20 REM-093 scan) fixed ONLY in the new 1.0.0-beta release line, so the pinned rustfs_version 1.0.0-alpha.93 AND the REM-093 bump target 1.0.0-alpha.98 are BOTH below the fix and remain affected -> REM-093's alpha.98 target is now STALE and the real fix target advances to 1.0.0-beta.9. CLUSTER: (1) CVE-2026-55188 (HIGH CVSS 8.2, GHSA-796f-j7xp-hwf4) -- the ListRemoteTargetHandler bucket-replication admin API checks only that request credentials EXIST, not that the caller holds replication/admin permission, so any authenticated user with no effective permissions can list a bucket's remote replication targets, and the returned BucketTarget objects INCLUDE the remote target access key + secret key (credential disclosure); affected 1.0.0-alpha.1..<beta.9, fix beta.9. (2) CVE-2026-49991 (HIGH CVSS 8.6, GHSA-f4vq-9ffr-m8m3) -- Snowball auto-extract path traversal: an authenticated user holding only PutObject on their own bucket injects objects ACROSS bucket boundaries (multi-tenant isolation break, CWE-22); affected through 1.0.0-beta.4, fixed in the beta line. (3) CVE-2026-55189 (HIGH CVSS 7.7, GHSA-3g29-xff2-92vp) -- the FTP frontend RETR/SIZE/MDTM/CWD handlers dispatch straight to the storage backend WITHOUT the IAM authorization call the FTP write/list handlers (and the whole HTTP S3 path) use, so any FTP-authenticated user (even one whose IAM policy carries an explicit Deny on s3:GetObject) can read + stat + probe any object in any bucket regardless of policy; affected 1.0.0-alpha.1..<beta.9, fix beta.9 -- reachable ONLY if the RustFS FTP frontend is enabled (nOS does NOT enable it by default -> latent here). (4) CVE-2026-55838 (MEDIUM CVSS 4.3, GHSA-f5cv-v44x-2xgf) -- /rustfs/admin/v3/metrics skips validate_admin_request, so any IAM user (even one scoped to only their own bucket) reads server-wide operational metrics (disk I/O, network throughput, scanner-cycle timing, cluster RPC state); affected <=1.0.0-beta.7, fix beta.7/beta.9. (5) GHSA-7gcx-wg4x-q9x6 (CRITICAL) 'Incomplete fix: Critical Stored XSS in Preview Modal' -- the earlier CVE-2026-27822 console preview-modal stored XSS (nominally covered by alpha.93 at its alpha.83 fix) had an INCOMPLETE fix; the COMPLETE fix lands only in the beta line. This is the PROBE-RELEVANT leg (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan focus): the RustFS web console (9001) is the ONLY Traefik-routed RustFS surface and its router carries traefik_auth_modes['rustfs']='none' (NO authentik@file forward-auth), relying solely on RustFS's own beta-grade credential login -- so a stored XSS firing JavaScript in the console context steals the S3 admin access/secret keys from localStorage -> full console/account takeover, an especially sharp risk with install_rustfs=true (Tier-1 storage ON by default). PROBE verdict: the genuinely-UNAUTHENTICATED leg remains CVE-2026-40937 (REM-093, notification-target webhook config, still valid); the rest of the June cluster is authenticated (FTP/IAM users) EXCEPT the auth:none-console-reachable stored XSS. nOS MITIGATION lowering real-world reach: the S3 + admin API (RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET) binds 127.0.0.1:9010 loopback / Docker shared_net only (NOT external); only the console (9001) is edge-routed; the FTP frontend and bucket replication are NOT configured by default (so 55189 + 55188 are latent). ACTION: bump rustfs_version 1.0.0-alpha.93 -> 1.0.0-beta.9 (default.config.yml source-of-truth + mirror roles/pazny.rustfs/defaults/main.yml per version-pins-default-config-shadow) -- clears the entire June cluster AND supersedes REM-093's alpha.98 target with margin; ALSO gate the console router with authentik@file forward-auth (flip traefik_auth_modes['rustfs']='proxy') as defense-in-depth against the console-XSS class. Already covered by the current alpha.93 pin, recorded for lineage (fix <= alpha.83, no incremental action beyond the incomplete-fix caveat): CVE-2026-27822 (Critical Stored XSS console preview modal, fix alpha.83 -- but the COMPLETE fix needs beta.9, see above) + CVE-2026-27607 (presigned POST-policy validation bypass -> arbitrary object write + content-length/content-type-constraint bypass, fix alpha.83). Supersedes/extends REM-093 (same rustfs_version bump, higher target).
items.resolution: rustfs 1.0.0-alpha.93 -> 1.0.0-beta.9; live-verified iiab-rustfs-1 healthy on beta.9 (reads alpha.93 data, converge failed=0). Real version fix.

items.remediation_detail: SUPPLY-CHAIN REPRODUCIBILITY GAP (not a live CVE). tileserver-gl is CVE-CLEAN in the 12-mo window: CVE-2024-35627 (reflected XSS, <=4.4.10) and CVE-2025-46653 (DoS, fix 5.3.0-r1) both predate any reasonable pin, and CVE-2025-44136/44137 (XSS + directory traversal) are MapTiler Tileserver-PHP -- a DIFFERENT product (nOS runs the Node maptiler/tileserver-gl), N/A. BUT the unauthenticated_endpoint_scan re-check found a version-pin SHADOW: default.config.yml sets maps_tileserver_version='latest' (line ~1213) while roles/pazny.offline_maps/defaults sets 'v5.6.0' -- and default.config.yml WINS (config-is-source-of-truth), so the EFFECTIVE running tag is the FLOATING 'latest', NOT the pinned v5.6.0 the prior cycle-16 batch-3 scan-state note asserted. Floating 'latest' floats past every known CVE (so no exposure today) but is non-reproducible and can silently pull a future regression/backdoored image -- same class as puter FROM :latest (REM-108), woodpecker 'v3' (REM-105), paperclip feature-SHA (REM-097). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): tileserver's Traefik router is traefik_auth_modes.offline_maps='none' (public tiles BY DESIGN, no Authentik provider), so when enabled it is edge-reachable unauthenticated -- but install_offline_maps=false by default AND 127.0.0.1:8070 loopback bind (LAN only if services_lan_access=true) -> no live external surface. The --public_url-absent Host/X-Forwarded header reflection remains theoretical (Traefik fixes the Host header upstream). FIX: pin maps_tileserver_version to an explicit immutable tag (e.g. 'v5.6.0', matching the role default) or a tag@sha256 digest in default.config.yml; align the two files. --- RESOLVED 2026-07-28 (bookkeeping catch-up, not new work): the pin is ALREADY maps_tileserver_version='v5.6.0' at default.config.yml:1295 and iiab-tileserver-1 is RUNNING maptiler/tileserver-gl:v5.6.0. The item's 'latest (effective) / v5.6.0 (role default, shadowed)' framing is inverted relative to the current tree — default.config.yml carries the pin, so the shadow resolves to v5.6.0, not to latest.

OVERTURNS the prior batch-4 (2026-06-23) 'clean' disposition: a June-2026 FreeScout advisory cluster (CVE IDs assigned after app 1.8.219) version-flags the pinned build. FOUR HIGH/CRITICAL, all fixed ABOVE the pin: (1) HEADLINE CVE-2026-53595 (GHSA-jqj5-r72v-v29g, CRITICAL CVSS 9.4) -- UNAUTHENTICATED account takeover on MySQL/MariaDB: a %20/empty-string invite_hash collision at /user-setup plus a graceful-fail expiry check lets an anonymous attacker reset ANY agent/admin email+password -> full mailbox + customer-data access. nOS runs MariaDB = exactly the vulnerable backend. Fix 1.8.224. (2) CVE-2026-53593 (GHSA-27vp-fpg8-j8wv, HIGH 8.8) -- authenticated RCE via .pht upload (incomplete denylist bypasses the CVE-2025-48471 fix; executes as PHP on the image's Apache mod_php); any low-priv agent. Fix 1.8.224. (3) CVE-2026-53591 (GHSA-8vm3-wwq4-ggfx, HIGH 8.6) -- UNAUTHENTICATED conversation-thread injection: HMAC verified only when the hash is exactly 16 chars, so any other length bypasses -> inject/forge customer replies + reopen closed tickets via crafted In-Reply-To + guessed sequential thread ID. Fix 1.8.223. (4) CVE-2026-48812 (GHSA-wg74-ww4w-2qpc, HIGH 7.5) -- UNAUTHENTICATED legacy-attachment access in routes/open.php (broken AND-condition token check) -> enumerate/download any legacy attachment (sequential IDs). Fix 1.8.221. Also GHSA-6r38-6mcf-2ww3 (agent-impersonation HMAC, HIGH, fix 1.8.220) subsumed by the bump. Already-resolved REM-029/069/070/071 (CVE-2026-28289/27636/32752/35584/39384) remain covered. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): three of the four legs are UNAUTHENTICATED and hit /user-setup, the inbound-email/thread path, and routes/open.php -- all reachable at the helpdesk.<tld> route because traefik_auth_modes.freescout='oidc' (native OIDC, 200 at edge, NOT forward-auth gated); 127.0.0.1:8090 loopback blocks direct host access but the edge route leaves the unauth CRIT takeover live for any operator with the b2b stack enabled (install_freescout default-on; services_lan_access=false by default). EXPLOITABLE (edge-routed). ACTION: bump freescout_version to a tiredofit build bundling >=1.8.224 in default.config.yml (line ~1873) AND roles/pazny.freescout/defaults/main.yml (version-pin-shadow rule) -- NOTE the upstream image renamed php8.3-1.17.x -> 2.x.x and 2.1.1 deprecates SITE_URL->APP_URL, so the compose template (roles/pazny.freescout/templates/compose.yml.j2, sets SITE_URL) needs the env rename, not just a tag swap; verify arm64 manifest + build->app map via the nfrastack CHANGELOG (same method as REM-069). Strongly consider flipping traefik_auth_modes.freescout->'proxy' (forward-auth) as defense-in-depth so the unauth legs are gated at the edge.

A June-24-2026 Jellyfin advisory version-flags the pinned 10.11.8. HEADLINE CVE-2026-48793 (GHSA-wwwm-px48-fpvq, HIGH CVSS 8.8, CWE-88) -- FFmpeg ARGUMENT-INJECTION in the subtitle conversion path (SubtitleEncoder.ConvertTextSubtitleToSrtInternal): subtitle file paths are interpolated into the FFmpeg command line unsanitized; on Linux, double-quote chars in filenames inject arguments -> arbitrary file write + info disclosure. Reachable WITHOUT authentication via SubtitleController.GetSubtitle (no Authorize attribute). Advisory: 'all releases prior to 10.11.10 are vulnerable.' DISTINCT from the covered CVE-2026-35031 (subtitle PATH-traversal RCE, fix 10.11.7) -- same subsystem, different flaw, fixed three patches later. Companion (fix 10.11.10, no CVE assigned): a jellyfin-web list-view XSS (PR #7955) shipped in the vulnerable web client bundled at 10.11.8 (MEDIUM confidence, moderate severity). Also newly-surfaced but ALREADY COVERED by 10.11.8 (fix 10.11.7, no action): CVE-2026-35033 (CRITICAL 9.3, unauth arbitrary file read via StreamOptions FFmpeg arg-injection). The Jun-10-2026 batch (GHSA-jg92 ClientLog traversal / GHSA-f47c MKV attachment / GHSA-fv79 user-mgmt XSS) is all below the HIGH gate. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): the role default sets jellyfin_lan_access=true -> binds 0.0.0.0:8096 (LAN-exposed, NOT loopback-only) when enabled; install_jellyfin=false by default so the fleet baseline is off, but any tenant that enables it gets a LAN-reachable, UNAUTHENTICATED FFmpeg arg-injection endpoint on a vulnerable pin -- Traefik/SSO (traefik_auth_modes.jellyfin='oidc' via the 9p4 SSO-Auth plugin) does NOT protect the raw :8096 port; /health is intentionally public. EXPLOITABLE-when-enabled (theoretical only where :8096 is unreachable / loopback-only). ACTION: bump jellyfin_version 10.11.8 -> 10.11.10 (or 10.11.11, latest 10.11.x) in default.config.yml (line ~1529) AND roles/pazny.jellyfin/defaults/main.yml (line ~10, version-pin-shadow rule); SSO-Auth plugin 4.0.0.4 stays ABI-compatible within 10.11.x, no plugin change. [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

Coverage-gap fill (not a fresh post-scan disclosure): CVE-2026-7709 (NVD CVSS 3.1 6.3 MEDIUM; VulDB mislabels it 'critical') -- IDOR / improper authorization (CWE-285) in generate_auth_token (cps/kobo_auth.py), route /kobo_auth/generate_auth_token/<int:user_id>. An authenticated low-priv user requests ANOTHER user's Kobo sync auth-token by changing user_id -> account impersonation. Affected janeczku calibre-web 0.6.0-0.6.26 -> the pinned 0.6.26 is IN the affected window (high confidence, NVD-confirmed). This IS the janeczku/linuxserver WEB APP (not desktop Calibre/calibre-ebook -- CVE-2026-26064/25635/27810 are the desktop product, correctly excluded). NO janeczku fix exists (vendor unresponsive, upstream dormant at 0.6.26/2025-02-06); the maintained fork Calibre-Web-Automated fixed the equivalent bug as CVE-2026-7713 in v4.0.7. TIMING: published 2026-05-03, last-modified 2026-06-17 -- it predates the 2026-06-24 prior scan but was never tracked (no REM item, no mention in REM-074) = a coverage gap from the prior scan, now closed. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): MITIGATED -- traefik_auth_modes.calibre_web='proxy' (Authentik authentik@file forward-auth wall in front of the edge route) + 127.0.0.1:8083 loopback + gated_net only (SEC-02, no shared_net/iiab_net, peer containers cannot reach :8083) + Tier 3. The IDOR requires an AUTHENTICATED calibre-web session, and reaching the app first requires passing the Authentik SSO wall -> residual risk is one authenticated Tier-3 SSO user impersonating another user's Kobo token (cross-tenant/insider concern, not anonymous). Same perimeter that neutralizes REM-074's unauth ReDoS. ACTION (low urgency): real fix path is identical to REM-074 -- migrate to the maintained Calibre-Web-Automated fork (Kobo IDOR fixed v4.0.7); no janeczku version bump available. REM-074 itself re-verified, not re-reported.
items.resolved_detail: MITIGATED by architecture (same as REM-074): calibre-web forward_auth-gated (authentik@file), unauth login/ReDoS surface unreachable without SSO session (books.pazny.eu/login → 302). Upstream janeczku unmaintained; Autocaliweb 0.7.1 migration = follow-up. 2026-07-24.

items.remediation_detail: HedgeDoc YAML alias-expansion DoS (CVE-2026-58486 / GHSA-qj78-mjch-wwrv, CVSS 8.3 HIGH, fixed 1.11.0 released 2026-06-18): a low-priv authenticated user crafts a note whose YAML frontmatter uses recursive alias expansion ('billion laughs'); opening that note's publish/editor view blocks the Node.js event loop -> instance-wide DoS for every user. Advisory states all instances running <=1.10.8 are affected; pinned hedgedoc_version 1.10.7 (roles/pazny.hedgedoc/defaults/main.yml) is in range. The SAME 1.11.0 bump also clears the 2026-06-18 moderate cluster: GHSA-2f9f-w8xq-276v (rate-limit bypass via CF-Connecting-IP header spoof), GHSA-6c2w-8w96-3pcv (stored HTML injection via email local-part), GHSA-8v9p-5j95-826j (CSRF in GitHub-Gist export callback -- N/A, nOS uses Authentik OIDC only, no Gist integration). ACTION: bump hedgedoc_version 1.10.7->1.11.0 in roles/pazny.hedgedoc/defaults/main.yml (NOTE: 1.11.0 drops Node 18, requires Node 20+ -- the quay.io/hedgedoc/hedgedoc:1.11.0 image bundles it). MITIGATED (probe unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): CMD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=false + CMD_ALLOW_EMAIL_REGISTER=false -> note creation requires an authenticated Authentik SSO session (native_oidc, traefik_auth_modes.hedgedoc=oidc, 200 at edge, own login); install_hedgedoc=false default; 127.0.0.1:3012 loopback -> NOT anonymously reachable = insider-scoped authenticated DoS, not an unauth vector. COVERED at 1.10.7: CVE-2026-25642/GHSA-x74j-jmf9-534w (upload-file security headers, fix 1.10.6), GHSA-672m-p72w-gw28 (SVG-upload XSS, 1.10.6), CVE-2025-66629/GHSA-6wm6-3vpq-6qvv (OAuth2 missing-state CSRF, 1.10.4), GHSA-gmgw-rcmh-7x47 (iframe cross-site, 1.10.4), GHSA-gw77-7r3c-4cm3 (SAML shared-user HIGH 7.6, fix 1.10.2 -- also N/A, OIDC not SAML). [RESOLVED 2026-07-13: pin bumped in default.config.yml, live-verified — running image + smoke 49/49.]

Cycle-16 batch-23 CVE scan (2026-07-08). The pinned bookstack_version 'v26.05-ls264' (default.config.yml + role default in sync) is the LSIO build of BookStack BASE 26.05, which is behind TWO upstream security releases: v26.05.1 (2026-06-09) fixes an attachment-authorization info leak (attachment requests could be manipulated to leak details/links/metadata of attachments the requesting user has NO permission to view) + a file:// protocol abuse that could auto-run credentialed requests when viewing exports (Windows-specific); v26.05.2 (2026-07-02) fixes edge-case vulns in URL filtering, redirect handling and permission checking, plus bundled-dependency updates. Upstream advises upgrading for instances with public access OR where untrusted users can edit content -- nOS BookStack is a multi-user Tier-2 wiki, so both apply. The earlier CVE-2026-5484 (auth bypass in the Chapter Export chapterToMarkdown handler -> export restricted pages as Markdown, fix 26.03.1) is ALREADY COVERED by the 26.05 base pin (26.05 > 26.03.1). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): NOT an unauth exposure -- every leg requires an authenticated session; traefik_auth_modes.bookstack='oidc' (native OIDC, 200 at edge, own /login + Sign-in-with-Authentik) gates the app, and 127.0.0.1:3013 loopback (services_lan_access=false) blocks direct host access. Residual = an authenticated low-privilege wiki user reading attachments/pages they should not, or the export-redirect edge cases -> MEDIUM. ACTION: bump bookstack_version 'v26.05-ls264' -> the LSIO tag tracking BookStack >=26.05.2 (e.g. 'v26.05.2-ls<build>') in default.config.yml + roles/pazny.bookstack/defaults/main.yml together (version-pin-shadow rule); confirm the arm64 LSIO build exists and re-pull the container.
items.resolved_detail: Pin bumped + live-applied via nos-stacks; container healthy on new tag (bookstack 26.05.2). Verified 2026-07-24.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-23 CVE scan (2026-07-08), Wing dependency hygiene. files/anatomy/wing/composer.lock ships guzzlehttp/psr7 2.9.0 and guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.10.0 (composer.json floors are ^2.7 / ^7.9), both inside the May-Jun-2026 Guzzle advisory ranges. psr7 2.9.0 < 2.10.2: CVE-2026-49214 (CRLF injection via URI host component), CVE-2026-48998 (Host confusion via authority reinterpretation -- 'trusted@evil' -> host evil), CVE-2026-55766 (CRLF injection in HTTP start-line serialization). guzzle 7.10.0 < 7.12.1: CVE-2026-55767 (dot-only cookie domains match all hosts), CVE-2026-55568 (silent HTTPS-proxy downgrade to cleartext -- N/A, requires libcurl < 7.50.2; nOS macOS/Linux ship far newer libcurl). N/A: CVE-2026-53723 (guzzle-services XML injection) -- wing does NOT depend on guzzlehttp/guzzle-services (grep-confirmed, not in composer.lock). REACHABILITY = LOW: wing's Guzzle usage is OUTBOUND-only to fixed, trusted endpoints -- the Anthropic API (anthropic-ai/sdk) and the loopback OTLP collector (open-telemetry/exporter-otlp) -- and does NOT build PSR-7 URIs from attacker-controlled inbound HTTP (inbound request parsing is Nette\Http, not Guzzle psr7 ServerRequest), so the Host-confusion / CRLF legs have no reachable attack path here; this is supply-chain hygiene against the committed lockfile, not a live exploit. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): no anonymous surface -- wing is forward_auth (traefik_auth_modes.wing='proxy', authentik@file gates the route) + FrankenPHP Caddyfile bound 127.0.0.1:9000 + admin off. ACTION (low urgency, per the nOS composer.lock discipline in CLAUDE.md): cd files/anatomy/wing && composer update guzzlehttp/psr7 guzzlehttp/guzzle --no-install ; git add composer.lock (regenerates the pins to >=2.10.2 / >=7.12.1); the pytest lockfile-sync gate + operator-side composer validate keep json/lock in sync. Nette/Latte carry NO 2025/2026 CVE (re-verified clean); frankenphp_version 1.12.4 covers the 2026 Caddy/FrankenPHP cluster (see REM-batch-8 wing note). --- RESOLVED 2026-07-28 (bookkeeping catch-up): composer.json already requires guzzlehttp/guzzle ^7.12.1 and guzzlehttp/psr7 ^2.10.2, and composer.lock ships guzzle 7.15.1 / psr7 2.13.0 — both ABOVE the fix floor including the refined CVE-2026-55766 target 2.12.1. The batch-30 note ('composer.lock still ships psr7 2.9.0 / guzzle 7.10.0') was accurate on 2026-07-19 and was overtaken without the queue being updated.

Cycle-16 batch-24 RE-SCAN (2026-07-09, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). The pinned ntfy_version v2.22.0 (roles/pazny.ntfy/defaults/main.yml) is version-flagged by GHSA-j8hr-p342-xrmh -- a stored XSS via SVG attachment preview: an attacker uploads a crafted SVG, and when a victim previews that attachment in the ntfy web UI the SVG's script executes same-origin (blob-URL preview). Affects <= v2.22.0, FIXED in v2.23.0 (commit 2911340 restricts the publish-dialog local-file preview to png/jpg/gif/webp). This is a repo-level advisory with NO CVE assigned (absent from the global GitHub Advisory DB + OSV.dev, which return zero ntfy entries); no official CVSS -- stored-XSS class, rated MEDIUM here. REACHABILITY: this is AUTHENTICATED-VICTIM / CLIENT-SIDE -- code runs only when an authenticated user previews the malicious attachment; there is NO unauthenticated server-side trigger, so it is OUT of scope for the unauthenticated_endpoint_scan focus and does not present as an anon endpoint hit. MITIGATED at the nOS perimeter: install_ntfy=false (off by default), traefik_auth_modes.ntfy=proxy (authentik@file forward-auth gates the web UI + admin surface at ntfy.<tld>, so the preview path sits behind the Authentik wall), container host-maps only to 127.0.0.1:2586 loopback (LAN bind only when services_lan_access=true) -> the vulnerable preview flow is not anonymously edge-reachable = insider-scoped authed XSS. CURRENCY: v2.22.0 is 3 minor releases behind latest v2.25.0 (v2.23.0 added anti-enumeration per-visitor topic-creation rate-limit; v2.24.0 fixed case-insensitive ACL topic-matching on SQLite; v2.25.0 switched token/ID/magic-link generation to crypto/rand). CVE-2026-39087 (the SSRF via unanchored web-push URL regex, NVD 6.4) stays RESOLVED at v2.22.0 = REM-087 (the v2.21->v2.22 bump was the fix, re-verified). ACTION (defense-in-depth, low urgency): bump ntfy_version v2.22.0 -> v2.25.0 (min v2.23.0) in roles/pazny.ntfy/defaults/main.yml; clears the stored-SVG-XSS plus the ACL/token-entropy hardening.
