items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-25 RE-SCAN (2026-07-11, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). Vaultwarden 1.36.0 (the current release, superseding the 1.35.x line) ships a cluster of security advisories NOT present in the pinned vaultwarden_version 1.35.8 (default.config.yml + role default in sync); several are UNAUTHENTICATED = the probe-relevant leg the prior batch-11 REM-095 disposition (resolved at 1.35.8) did not yet cover. Advisories (private/pending-CVE at release, GHSA-tracked): (1) SSO Login CSRF -- GHSA-pfp2-jhgq-6hg5 + GHSA-w6h6-8r66-hcv7 (UNAUTH, cross-site request forgery against the SSO auth callback -> can bind/complete an SSO login flow chosen by the attacker); (2) User/Organization Enumeration -- GHSA-hxqh-ff5p-wfr3 (UNAUTH info-disclosure, distinguishes existing vs non-existing accounts/orgs); (3) SSRF via Icon Endpoint -- GHSA-72vh-x5jq-m82g (UNAUTH server-side request forgery via the /icons/ favicon fetcher -> internal-network probing); (4) SSO Existing-User Binding -- GHSA-j4j8-gpvj-7fqr + GHSA-6x5c-84vm-5j56 (auth-bypass class, binds an SSO identity onto an existing local user). nOS runs Vaultwarden with SSO via Authentik OIDC, so the SSO-flow legs (1)+(4) are in the applicable surface. ALREADY COVERED at 1.35.8 (no action, logged for lineage): CVE-2026-43912 (cross-organization data access, fixed 1.35.5) -- 1.35.8 > 1.35.5. MITIGATED at the nOS perimeter: 127.0.0.1:8062 loopback bind (services_lan_access=false blocks direct host access), native_oidc Tier-3 Authentik gate on the edge route (traefik_auth_modes.vaultwarden=oidc, 200 at edge -- own login + Authentik button, NOT forward-auth), SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false. The SSO CSRF / icon SSRF / enumeration legs require reaching the Vaultwarden HTTP surface, which on the default posture is loopback + the Authentik-fronted route -> not anonymously edge-reachable in the same way an internet-exposed instance would be = residual is insider/LAN-scoped, hence MEDIUM not HIGH. ACTION: bump vaultwarden_version 1.35.8 -> 1.36.0 in default.config.yml AND roles/pazny.vaultwarden/defaults/main.yml together (version-pin-shadow rule); 1.36.0 also bundles Web Vault 2026.4.1 (carries CVE-2026-27801/27802/27803/27898 web-vault fixes already covered server-side) and adds item-archiving + a prelogin password endpoint (behavior-additive). REM-095 (1.35.4/1.35.5 authed cluster) + REM-019/049/050 remain resolved at the pin.
items.resolution: live-verified: iiab-vaultwarden-1 running vaultwarden/server:1.36.0 healthy.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-25 RE-SCAN (2026-07-11, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). CVE-2026-5757 (CERT/CC VU#518910, 'Ollama GGUF Quantization Remote Memory Leak') -- an UNAUTHENTICATED remote information-disclosure flaw in Ollama's model quantization engine, DISTINCT from the covered CVE-2026-7482 'Bleeding Llama' (REM-096, /api/create GGUF loader OOB-read, fixed 0.17.1). Here the quantization engine trusts tensor metadata in a user-supplied GGUF file header without verifying it against the actual data size: an attacker uploads a crafted GGUF and triggers quantization, causing an out-of-bounds heap read whose leaked bytes are written into a NEW model layer, which Ollama's registry API can then /api/push to an attacker-controlled server -> full heap exfiltration (env vars/API keys/system prompts/other users' conversation data), same impact class as CVE-2026-7482. STATUS: UNPATCHED -- per CERT/CC the vendor could not be reached to coordinate and no fix release exists (zero-day; interim guidance = restrict/disable the model-upload + quantization functionality in any environment exposed to untrusted users). This is NOT closable by a version bump (unlike REM-096), so it parallels the REM-064 'no upstream fix' pattern -- the control is perimeter, not a patch. nOS MITIGATION (the decisive control): Ollama is the HOST Homebrew install (roles/pazny.openclaw), and its launchd plist (roles/pazny.openclaw/templates/com.ollama.agent.plist.j2) hard-sets OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 -- the API (incl. the /api/create quantization + /api/push registry endpoints) binds LOOPBACK ONLY, not 0.0.0.0, so the unauthenticated attack surface is not reachable from the LAN/Tailscale; only the on-host OpenClaw gateway consumes it. There is NO ollama_version var to pin (same host-install reality as REM-024/REM-096). NOT applicable: CVE-2026-42248/42249 (Windows auto-updater signature-verify RCE) -- macOS/Linux Homebrew build. RESIDUAL RISK: a local/on-host process (or a compromised OpenClaw agent) could still trigger it; when an upstream fix ships, the floating brew state=latest install will pick it up automatically (verify via REM-024). ACTION: keep OLLAMA_HOST bound to 127.0.0.1 (already enforced -- do NOT set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0); operator-side brew-currency watch for the eventual fix release (cross-ref REM-024).
items.resolution: No upstream fix — CVE-2026-5757 (GGUF quantization heap leak) is UNPATCHED; CERT/CC (VU#518910) could not reach the vendor. Distinct from CVE-2026-7482 Bleeding Llama (fixed 0.17.1 < our 0.30.7). Vendor-blocked like FreePBX: unfixable in the current upstream. Residual controls (loopback 127.0.0.1 bind + SSO gate) noted but do NOT constitute a fix. Re-evaluate on an ollama patch.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-28 (2026-07-15, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). The July-8-2026 Traefik release wave (v3.6.22 + v3.6.23) version-flags the pinned traefik_image_version v3.6.21 (default.config.yml + role default in sync). PRIMARY: CVE-2026-54763 (GHSA-x677-9fxg-v5c5, HIGH -- ForwardAuth-specific base CVSS 9.1, BasicAuth/DigestAuth base 7.5; affects v3 <= v3.6.21 and <= v3.7.5; fixed v3.6.22 / v3.7.6 / v2.11.51) = an INCOMPLETE FIX for CVE-2026-33433 (REM-025, resolved). The original patch strips spoofed auth headers with Go's Header.Del, which canonicalizes via textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey -- that treats '-' as a word separator but NOT '_', so an attacker can inject UNDERSCORE-VARIANT header names (X_authentik_username, X_authentik_groups) that survive Traefik's strip and reach the backend intact; exploitable when the backend normalizes '_'=='-' (PHP/CGI/WSGI $_SERVER -> HTTP_X_AUTHENTIK_*, nginx underscores_in_headers on, Tomcat/servlet, ASGI). nOS is IN the applicable surface: middlewares.yml.j2 defines the 'authentik' forwardAuth middleware with trustForwardHeader:true + authResponseHeaders X-authentik-username/uid/email/name/groups -- the X-authentik-groups header drives the RBAC tier mapping, so an underscore-spoof is an identity/authorization forgery on the core SSO gate. COMPANION: CVE-2026-54764 (MEDIUM, CVSS v3 5.8 -- ForwardAuth X-Forwarded-Proto injection: an unauth client sends 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' over plain HTTP so Traefik forwards X-Forwarded-Port:443 to the auth service, bypassing port-based authorization checks; same trustForwardHeader:true surface; fixed v3.6.22). N/A (recorded for lineage): GHSA-cxjq-mrr5-89rv (HIGH 7.8, ReplacePathRegex auth-bypass via post-replacement path traversal, no CVE assigned, fixed v3.6.23) -- grep-confirmed nOS uses NO ReplacePathRegex/replacePath middleware anywhere (roles/pazny.traefik middlewares are authentik forwardAuth + security-headers + https-redirect + compress + wing-edge + optional miniflux redirectRegex); GHSA-42cj-m3vj-89wv (CRD IngressRouteTCP ServersTransport cross-provider bypass) + GHSA-qq9q-x9w4-chhj / GHSA-6p8f-p8j2-rqmv (Gateway API HTTPRoute namespace confusion) -- Kubernetes-CRD/Gateway-provider ONLY, N/A to nOS (Docker provider + file provider, no K8s Gateway/CRD). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): the forwardAuth flow only ADDS authResponseHeaders after Authentik auth PASSES and does not forward to the backend on auth failure -> the underscore-spoof is not a pure-unauth bypass; a session must first clear the Authentik wall. RESIDUAL: (a) the forward_auth pure-gate services (Uptime Kuma, Calibre-Web, Kiwix, Puter, code-server, ntfy, Metabase, etc.) do NOT read X-authentik-* for identity -> spoof is inert there; (b) the header_oidc services that DO consume per-user headers -- Firefly III (PHP, HTTP_X_AUTHENTIK_USERNAME -> underscore collides) + KEAP (X-Authentik-uid) -- are the genuine target: an AUTHENTICATED low-priv Tier user could inject X_authentik_groups:nos-admins / X_authentik_username:<victim> to escalate or impersonate. SEC-02 network isolation does NOT cover this (edge path, not peer-container). MITIGATED to authenticated-insider escalation, not internet-anon. ACTION: bump traefik_image_version v3.6.21 -> v3.6.23 (default.config.yml + role default together; version-pin shadow) -- v3.6.23 is the latest 3.6 patch and clears CVE-2026-54763 + CVE-2026-54764 (at v3.6.22) plus the N/A ReplacePathRegex GHSA-cxjq (at v3.6.23), no config change. REM-015/025/061/075/076/077 remain resolved at the prior pins.
items.resolution: Bumped traefik_image_version v3.6.21 -> v3.6.23 (default.config.yml source-of-truth + role default aligned). v3.6.22 clears CVE-2026-54763/54764; v3.6.23 also clears the N/A ReplacePathRegex GHSA (lineage). Live-verified: infra-traefik-1 running traefik:v3.6.23 healthy, routes green (keap 302->Authentik). Committed b3b87739.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-30 CVE scan (2026-07-19), Bone dependency hygiene. CVE-2026-48710 'BadHost' (GHSA-86qp-5c8j-p5mr, disclosed 2026-05-22, fixed Starlette 1.0.1 on 2026-05-21) is an UNAUTHENTICATED host-header auth-bypass in Starlette < 1.0.1, the ASGI framework that powers FastAPI: a Host header containing '/', '?' or '#' shifts where the path begins so request.url.path no longer matches the raw ASGI scope path, letting middleware/endpoints that gate on request.url be bypassed. Bone is a FastAPI app (main.py: app=FastAPI(...)) with an UNPINNED floor fastapi>=0.115 and NO explicit starlette pin and NO committed lockfile (requirements.txt only), so a venv built before the FastAPI release that requires Starlette>=1.0.1 could transitively resolve a vulnerable Starlette. Bone is a Tier-1 manifest service routed at api.<tld> with traefik_auth_modes.bone='none' (no forward-auth wall) -> the unauth-exposed surface that makes BadHost probe-relevant. REACHABILITY = LOW / architecturally NOT exploitable: grep-confirmed bone uses NO middleware at all (no app.add_middleware, no TrustedHostMiddleware, no request.url / base_url read anywhere in *.py) -- its auth is per-route Depends(require_scope('nos:...')) which validates an Authentik-issued JWT bearer token via JWKS (auth.py, algorithms=['RS256']), keyed on the Authorization header, NOT on request.url. FastAPI routing still dispatches on the raw ASGI scope path, so require_scope fires on the actual endpoint regardless of Host-header manipulation; the only ungated route /api/health is public by design. BadHost therefore grants an attacker nothing bone doesn't already expose and does NOT bypass the scope gates -- this is supply-chain/dependency hygiene, not a live bypass. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): the scope-gated read endpoints (/api/services, /api/status, /api/health/aggregate) are already closed by REM-110 (resolved 2026-07-08, require_scope('nos:state:read') verified present); 127.0.0.1:8099 loopback host-bind limits direct host access. ACTION (low urgency, mirrors the wing REM-123 lockfile-discipline pattern): pin starlette>=1.0.1 (or bump the fastapi floor to a release that requires it) in files/anatomy/bone/requirements.txt AND add a committed lockfile pinning ALL bone deps (fastapi/uvicorn/httpx/PyYAML/PyJWT), the outstanding hardening item first named in the REM-110 dep-note. --- RESOLVED 2026-07-28 (bookkeeping catch-up): files/anatomy/bone/requirements.txt already carries an explicit 'starlette>=1.0.1' with a REM-128 comment, and the live bone venv reports starlette 1.3.1. The recommended ACTION was performed; only the queue entry lagged.

The SECOND half of wp2shell, untracked until now — nOS recorded only CVE-2026-63030. wp2shell is a CHAIN: CVE-2026-63030 (REST batch-route confusion) + CVE-2026-60137 (core SQL injection); chained they give unauthenticated RCE, and public exploits exist with in-the-wild exploitation reported. nOS's mu-plugin (roles/pazny.wordpress/files/cve-2026-63030-batch-block.php) unregisters /batch/v1, which breaks the chain at its entry point and is why the RCE is mitigated — but it does NOT patch the SQLi, which remains present in the pinned core 6.9.4. Residual risk is the SQLi standing alone (upstream indicates 6.8.0-6.8.5 carried the SQLi WITHOUT full chain exposure, so alone it is not RCE). BLOCKED ON THE SAME IMAGE LAG: fixed cores are 6.8.6/6.9.5/7.0.2 and the Docker official image publishes none of them; 7.0.0/7.0.1 ARE published but are in the CVE range, so they are not an escape. Resolve together with the 63030 mitigation removal the moment a fixed tag is dockerized. Compensating controls today: WordPress is native_oidc at the edge (anonymous reach to /wp-json is by design for a CMS), 127.0.0.1 loopback host bind, install_wordpress off by default. --- 2026-08-04 (cycle-21 batch-42) UNBLOCKED: the IMAGE-LAG-BLOCKED condition no longer holds. Docker Hub library/wordpress published the 7.0.2 tag family on 2026-08-02 (7.0.2, 7.0.2-apache, 7.0.2-php8.3-apache and siblings). 6.9.5 was never dockerized (the 6.9 tag family stops at 6.9.4, 2026-05-20), so 7.0.2 is the only dockerized fixed core. Execution is tracked as REM-160 -- bump the pin, then REMOVE the cve-2026-63030-batch-block.php mu-plugin, then close this item.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-31 (2026-07-21, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). OVERTURNS the 2026-07-09 'no new unauthenticated FreePBX CVE beyond REM-113' disposition: the July-17-2026 FreePBX advisory wave adds TWO UNAUTHENTICATED items in the probe-focus area. (1) GHSA-37j8-fhxx-9vhp (no CVE assigned; CVSS v4.0 base 9.3 CRITICAL, provider urgency Red) -- UNAUTHENTICATED RCE in the UCP Node server: socket.io v4 removed auth protections so the io.use(checkAuth) gate is bypassable, then crafted socket.io events inject Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI) actions -> arbitrary command execution as the asterisk system user; UCP Node listens on ports 8001 (non-TLS) / 8003 (TLS); fixed in UCP module 17.0.9. (2) Unauthenticated SQL injection in the missedcall module via inbound Caller-ID name -> administrator takeover; fixed missedcall 16.0.11 / 17.0.6. VENDOR-BLOCKED, same structural wall as REM-014/046/113: roles/pazny.freepbx pins tiredofit/freepbx whose last tag is 5.2.0 (2022-04-30, abandoned) and bundles FreePBX-15-era modules -- UCP 17.0.9 / missedcall 17.0.6 are unreachable and no maintained ARM64 FOSS FreePBX image exists. MITIGATED at the nOS perimeter with an EXTRA layer beyond REM-113: (a) the UCP Node ports 8001/8003 are NOT published in roles/pazny.freepbx/templates/compose.yml.j2 -- only :80 -> 127.0.0.1:8088 loopback, plus SIP 5060 / IAX 4569 / RTP 10000-10100 -- so the UCP RCE socket is unreachable from host, LAN, or Tailscale even when freepbx runs; (b) install_freepbx=false by default; (c) the manifest entry has port_var but NO domain_var so FreePBX is NOT Traefik-routed (no edge route); (d) web UI + missedcall live behind the 127.0.0.1:8088 loopback bind. Version-match confidence LOW: the socket.io-v4 bypass requires socket.io v4, which a FreePBX-15-era UCP likely predates; recorded here for lineage + honesty that a NEW unauth advisory landed in the probe window. Asterisk-core CVEs in the same wave (XSS/XXE/local-root) are local/adjacent-network, not pre-auth network RCE.
items.blocked_reason: tiredofit/freepbx image abandoned upstream 2022-04-30 (last tag 5.2.0, FreePBX-15-era); UCP 17.0.9 / missedcall 17.0.6 fixes unreachable, no maintained ARM64 FOSS alternative. UCP Node ports 8001/8003 unmapped + install_freepbx=false + not Traefik-routed + loopback-only mitigate at the perimeter.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-32 SCAN (2026-07-23, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). The pinned mailpit_version v1.30.3 (roles/pazny.mailpit/defaults/main.yml; no default.config.yml shadow) is version-flagged by a THREE-advisory post-v1.30.3 cluster, and -- unlike the REM-112 cluster it succeeds -- EVERY leg is UNAUTHENTICATED and network-triggered, which makes this batch's probe focus directly applicable. (1) GHSA-w878-pj84-3j5v (MODERATE, CVSS 5.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N, no CVE assigned, published 2026-07-09): the SMTP/POP3 command parser buffers a whole command line with an unbounded bufio.Reader.ReadString('\n') BEFORE parsing the verb or enforcing RFC-5321's 512-octet limit -> an unauthenticated SMTP client sends one oversized newline-less command line and forces unbounded allocation. Affects <= 1.30.3, FIXED 1.30.4. (2) GHSA-75mr-qw9x-3r39 (MODERATE, CVSS 5.3, no CVE, published 2026-07-09): the thumbnail endpoint fully decodes an attacker-supplied image attachment to a raster BEFORE any dimension / decoded-pixel / memory budget check -- a 65 KB compressed PNG expands to ~64 MB decoded (>1000x amplification); triggerable by calling the API directly OR by a UI message view. Affects <= 1.30.3, FIXED 1.30.4. (3) GHSA-r553-m4fv-5v97 (MODERATE, CVSS 5.3, no CVE, published 2026-07-20): the SMTP DATA reader buffers a complete line via ReadBytes('\n') BEFORE enforcing the configured MaxMessageSize, so a single oversized unterminated line (64 MiB tested) allocates well past the cap before rejection. Affects >= v1.30.0 <= v1.30.4, FIXED v1.30.5. All three are the same availability class (C:N/I:N/A:L -- memory/CPU pressure and service degradation, not RCE or data disclosure) and all three are the continuing incomplete-fix tail of the original HIGH unauth OOM item GHSA-fpxj-m5q8-fphw / CVE-2026-45713. COVERED AT THE PIN (re-verified, no action): CVE-2026-55187 (GHSA-w4mc-hhc6-xp28, IPv6 SSRF-guard bypass, fix 1.30.2), CVE-2026-48824 (GHSA-28pq-6qxg-wg5r, unbounded-JSON DoS on /api/v1/messages + /api/v1/tags + /api/v1/message/{id}/release, MED 5.3, fix 1.30.1), CVE-2026-45713 (fix 1.29.8), CVE-2026-27808 (GHSA-mpf7-p9x7-96r3, Link Check SSRF, fix 1.29.2), CVE-2026-22689 (CSWSH, fix 1.28.2), CVE-2026-23829 (SMTP header injection, fix 1.28.3) -- i.e. REM-081..085 + REM-112 all stay resolved at v1.30.3. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan) / MITIGATION: mailpit is the ONLY component in this batch that is install_mailpit=true BY DEFAULT, so version hygiene genuinely matters here. But the compose template maps ONLY 127.0.0.1:8025 (UI/REST) and 127.0.0.1:1025 (SMTP) -- UNCONDITIONALLY, with no services_lan_access escape hatch (unlike ntfy/onlyoffice/erpnext) -- and traefik_auth_modes.mailpit='proxy' puts authentik@file forward-auth in front of the UI + REST + thumbnail endpoints at mail.<tld>. So the thumbnail-decode leg is NOT anonymously edge-reachable. RESIDUAL (the honest part): the SMTP listener has no auth by design and is reachable from (a) any host-local process and (b) every container on the shared docker network that can resolve mailpit:1025 -- which is exactly what the sink exists for. So the two SMTP legs degrade to a container-local / host-local DoS, not an internet-anon one. NOT internet-exploitable; NOT a confidentiality or integrity issue. ACTION: bump mailpit_version v1.30.3 -> v1.30.5 (latest, released 2026-07-20) in roles/pazny.mailpit/defaults/main.yml. Pure image-tag bump, no config change. --- RESOLVED 2026-07-28 (bookkeeping catch-up): mailpit_version is ALREADY 'v1.30.5' (roles/pazny.mailpit/defaults/main.yml:21, no default.config.yml shadow) and iiab-mailpit-1 is RUNNING axllent/mailpit:v1.30.5 — the exact recommended target, closing all three post-v1.30.3 advisories.

Cycle-16 batch-32 SCAN (2026-07-23, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-124 (resolved 2026-07-16 -- the pin advanced v2.22.0 -> v2.23.0, live-verified iiab-ntfy-1 on binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.23.0, which closed the SVG-attachment-preview stored XSS GHSA-j8hr-p342-xrmh). The pin is now 3 minors + 3 patches behind latest v2.26.3 (2026-07-20), and each intervening minor carries an UNADVISED security fix -- ntfy's GitHub security-advisories page is EMPTY (0 published advisories) and OSV.dev/GHSA carry no ntfy entries, so these are release-note-level only, with NO CVE and NO vendor CVSS. Rated MEDIUM here on the token-predictability leg; do NOT cite a CVE for it. (1) v2.24.0 -- 'Fix case-insensitive ACL topic matching on SQLite': an access-control CORRECTNESS bug where topic ACL rules did not match as intended under SQLite, i.e. authorization could resolve differently than the administrator wrote it. (2) v2.25.0 -- 'Generate access tokens, IDs, and magic-link tokens with a cryptographically secure RNG (crypto/rand) instead of a clock-seeded PRNG': this is the significant one. A clock-seeded math/rand stream makes issued access tokens and magic-link tokens PREDICTABLE to an attacker who can constrain the seed (issuance time) -- a credential-guessing / auth-bypass class, and the only leg in this item with any unauthenticated-endpoint relevance (guessing a valid bearer token needs no prior session). (3) v2.26.0 -- 'Prevent a CPU denial of service via message templates (Template: yes)': template execution is now hard-capped with an execution timeout; before the cap, a publisher-supplied template could burn CPU unbounded. v2.26.3 (latest) carries no further security content. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan) / MITIGATION: no anonymous reach. install_ntfy=false (off by default); traefik_auth_modes.ntfy='proxy' so authentik@file forward-auth gates the web UI, admin surface AND the publish/API paths at ntfy.<tld>; the server config keeps auth-default-access=deny-all + enable-signup=false; the container host-maps only 127.0.0.1:2586 (LAN bind only when services_lan_access=true). The token-predictability leg is therefore reachable only by someone who already cleared the Authentik wall, and the template-DoS leg needs publish rights -> insider-scoped, not internet-anon. CVE-2026-39087 (SSRF via unanchored web-push URL regex, NVD 6.4 -- the widely-syndicated 'parseActions RCE' framing remains an AI-generated mislabel that contradicts NVD) stays RESOLVED via REM-087 at v2.22.0, re-verified. ACTION (defense-in-depth): bump ntfy_version v2.23.0 -> v2.26.3 in roles/pazny.ntfy/defaults/main.yml. Note the v2.25.0 RNG change does NOT retroactively rotate already-issued tokens -- if ntfy is ever enabled with tokens minted on <= v2.24.x, re-issue them after the bump.
items.resolved_detail: Pin bumped + live-applied via nos-stacks; container healthy on new tag (ntfy v2.26.3). Verified 2026-07-24.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-32 SCAN (2026-07-23, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-115 (closed 2026-07-16 as 'N/A in this deployment' with v15.104.3 recorded as the acceptance pin for a future un-parking). A NEW advisory published AFTER that closure ADVANCES the acceptance pin, so the recorded target must move or the parked-service rework would re-enable on a still-vulnerable build. CVE-2026-55242 (GHSA-pxf3-4gvc-v45j, HIGH CVSS 8.8, published 2026-07-04): Server-Side Template Injection via a configuration field allows unauthorized data disclosure -- an authenticated user holding a STANDARD OPERATIONAL role can read information well outside their authorization scope. DUAL-LINE fix, so the v15 backport is explicit and this is high-confidence: affects v15 < 15.111.0 and v16 < 16.22.0; FIXED 15.111.0 / 16.22.0. The pinned erpnext_version v15.98.1 (default.config.yml source-of-truth + roles/pazny.erpnext/defaults/main.yml, in sync) is squarely in the affected window, and is ALSO still short of the REM-115 cluster target 15.104.3 -- so a single bump to v15.111.0 clears BOTH: the SSTI plus the May-2026 cluster (CVE-2026-44446 SQLi dual-line fix 15.104.3 / 16.14.0; CVE-2026-44445 GHSA-mhm9-75w7-423r EDI-module XXE, dual-line fix 15.104.3 / 16.12.0; GHSA-6fm9-g88m-hxr7 SQLi, dual-line fix 15.104.3 / 16.14.0; CVE-2026-44442 GHSA-cg5w CRIT 9.9 authz bypass; CVE-2026-44447 GHSA-q65v HIGH 8.8 SQLi; GHSA-j669/wj7p SQLi; GHSA-r99h stored XSS; GHSA-6ffr path-traversal; GHSA-m4m4 authed SSRF; GHSA-444j doc-modification). GHSA-pxf3-4gvc-v45j is the NEWEST published ERPNext advisory as of this scan -- nothing after 2026-07-04. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): NOT an unauth exposure. CVE-2026-55242 explicitly requires an authenticated user with a standard operational role, and every other item in the inherited cluster is likewise authenticated (low-priv). The only historically-unauth ERPNext item, CVE-2026-27471 (CVSS 9.3 unauth document access), stays RESOLVED at the pin via REM-017. ERPNext's sole intentionally-public surface remains its own login page + /api/method/frappe.ping health. MITIGATED / ZERO LIVE EXPOSURE (unchanged from REM-115): install_erpnext=false AND the role is HARD-BLOCKED at load (requires erpnext_experimental_override=true; parked for rework per roles/pazny.erpnext/README.md and excluded from profiles/all-on.yml); the container host-maps 127.0.0.1:8082 loopback; traefik_auth_modes.erpnext='oidc' (native Frappe social_login_keys). Nothing is running, so nothing is reachable. Cycle-16 batch-33 SCAN (2026-07-24, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-098 (resolved; its target 1.31.2+ is now itself version-flagged). The nginx.org advisory page carries a NEW post-1.31.2 wave, all three fixed in 1.31.3+ / 1.30.4+. HEADLINE CVE-2026-42533 (severity MAJOR per nginx.org): buffer overflow when using `map` with a regex; affects 0.9.6-1.31.2 -- i.e. EVERY nginx release prior to 1.31.3, including whatever the host package currently resolves to. APPLICABILITY IS DIRECT, not latent: templates/nginx/nginx.conf:103 defines `map $uri $conn_limit_key { ~*\.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|ico|woff2?|ttf|eot|map|webp)$ ""; default $binary_remote_addr; }` -- a map keyed on the REQUEST URI with a case-insensitive regex arm, which is precisely the vulnerable construct. Because the map key is $uri, the regex is evaluated against an ATTACKER-CONTROLLED, UNAUTHENTICATED request path on EVERY request, before any auth/proxy decision -- this is the probe-focus leg. A second regex-free map exists in sites-available/code-server.conf:10 (`map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade`, literal arms only, not vulnerable). COMPANIONS (same fix line, LATENT not active): CVE-2026-60005 (MEDIUM, memory disclosure via ngx_http_slice_module, affects 1.15.8-1.31.2) -- grep-confirmed NO `slice` / `slice_` directive anywhere in templates/nginx/, so the module is compiled-but-unused; CVE-2026-56434 (MEDIUM, use-after-free in ngx_http_ssi_module, affects 0.8.11-1.31.2) -- grep-confirmed NO `ssi on` / `ssi_` directive, likewise compiled-but-unused. Same disposition class as the REM-063 DAV/MP4 items: they clear for free with the same bump. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): the map+regex path IS anonymously reachable on any host that opts into host-nginx, since $uri is evaluated in the http{} context ahead of every server/location block and ahead of the Authentik proxy-auth includes. MITIGATED: install_nginx=false is the DEFAULT (default.config.yml:355) -- Traefik is the primary edge proxy, so a stock nOS host runs no nginx at all and has zero exposure; and there is NO repo image pin to bump (host Homebrew on macOS / apt on Linux). ACTION: operator-side `brew upgrade nginx` / `apt upgrade nginx` to >= 1.31.3 (or >= 1.30.4 on the 1.30 branch) on any host that sets install_nginx=true. This ALSO supersedes the REM-098 target: 1.31.3 is a strict superset of 1.31.2, so a single upgrade clears the REM-098 cluster (CVE-2026-42945/42530/42055/9256 + 48142/42926/42946) and this one together. REM-010/035/063/098 remain resolved. CVE-2026-8711 (njs js_module) stays N/A -- module not compiled/loaded.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-33 SCAN (2026-07-24, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NOT a CVE -- hygiene/hardening item, recorded so the pin does not silently rot. SpacetimeDB has NEVER published a security advisory: the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB GitHub Security tab reads 'There aren't any published security advisories', and there is no OSV/NVD/CISA hit in the 12-month window. So the CVE leg of this scan is CLEAN, as in batch-9. WHAT CHANGED SINCE batch-9: the pin is no longer floating. spacetimedb_version advanced from 'latest' to v2.6.1 (default.config.yml:1588 source-of-truth + roles/pazny.spacetimedb/defaults/main.yml:27, in sync) explicitly for blank reproducibility -- which is a correctness win but also means the deployment no longer auto-inherits upstream fixes, so version drift now has to be tracked here. Upstream has since moved to v2.7.0-hotfix3 (latest at scan time; v2.6.1 was the newest when the pin was set). SECURITY-RELEVANT CONTENT of v2.7.0: 'Safer BSATN array decoding' -- prevents out-of-memory failures on adversarial or malformed inputs. Upstream frames this as a reliability improvement and assigned no CVE/GHSA, but BSATN is the wire encoding of SpacetimeDB's client protocol, so a malformed-input OOM guard sits directly on the network-facing deserialization path. Treated as an availability-class hardening fix, LOW severity, confidence medium (no advisory text to pin exact affected versions). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): NO external unauth surface. traefik_auth_modes.spacetimedb='none' (binary protocol, cannot carry a forward-auth redirect), but the container's internal --listen-addr=0.0.0.0:3000 host-maps ONLY to 127.0.0.1:<spacetimedb_port|3030> (roles/pazny.spacetimedb/templates/compose.yml.j2:21); it binds a LAN interface only when services_lan_access=true. Combined with install_spacetimedb=false (default.config.yml:424) and exclusion from profiles/all-on.yml, nothing runs and nothing is reachable -- the BSATN decode path is not anonymously exposed. ACTION: low-priority bump v2.6.1 -> v2.7.0-hotfix3, bumping default.config.yml AND roles/pazny.spacetimedb/defaults/main.yml together (default.config.yml wins at runtime). Verify the tag exists on Docker Hub before pinning, per the reproducibility rule that motivated the original pin. BSL 1.1, internal-SaaS use only.
items.resolution: Pin ADVANCED to the recommended target. default.config.yml:1591 and roles/pazny.spacetimedb/defaults/main.yml:27 both read spacetimedb_version: "v2.7.0-hotfix3" (was v2.6.1) — in sync, no dead-pin shadow. Verified 2026-07-26: v2.7.0-hotfix3 (published 2026-07-22) is STILL the newest clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release, so the deployment is at upstream head and carries the 'safer BSATN array decoding' adversarial-input OOM guard on the client-protocol deserialization path. CVE leg re-confirmed CLEAN: /repos/clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB/security-advisories returns an EMPTY list (no GHSA has ever been published) and an OSV query for the crate returns no match. Zero live exposure regardless (install_spacetimedb=false; container listener host-maps to 127.0.0.1 only).

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-34 SCAN (2026-07-26, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NEW, and it OVERTURNS the batch-33 (2026-07-24) 'vaultwarden is now CLEAN at 1.36.0' disposition by ~13 hours: Vaultwarden 1.37.0 was published 2026-07-24T17:04:39Z, whereas batch-33 ran at 04:08:55+02:00 (02:08 UTC) the same day — so the release did not exist at the prior scan. 1.37.0 bundles NINE advisories the pinned 1.36.0 lacks, ALL Medium, upstream wording 'We strongly advise to update as soon as possible': SSRF via the icon endpoint (GHSA-hw4g-2v3f-74x5 5.8 + GHSA-vh5m-fc9v-m84g 6.3 — a SECOND icon-SSRF wave, i.e. the incomplete-fix tail of CVE-2026-47160/GHSA-72vh-x5jq-m82g which 1.36.0 fixed), UNAUTHENTICATED WebSocket flooding DDoS (GHSA-96f7-78q5-j345 5.3), Cross-Organization Cipher Access (GHSA-xwf8-pjh7-h589 5.9), Organization Policy Bypass on Directory Import (GHSA-88qc-6ch9-mc3j 5.5), Send Access-Count Bypass (GHSA-rxhg-2pw9-vf25 5.3), Cross-Organization Secret Sharing (GHSA-455c-vgg9-jxw8 4.3), Organization Import Authorization (GHSA-f3qw-qg77-hmm4 + GHSA-jq2g-h4xr-4mcr 4.3), Organization Data Enumeration via the Manager role (GHSA-rqf8-2568-r7mc 4.3). CONFIDENCE medium on the per-advisory technical detail ONLY because upstream states 'These are private for now, pending CVE assignment' — the GHSA pages 404 and the GitHub advisory API (/repos/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/security-advisories) still returns only the <=2026-05-19 set; the EXISTENCE, IDs, severities and fix version are high-confidence (verbatim from the signed release body). No CVE IDs assigned yet — do NOT invent any. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan) — the two unauth legs are EDGE-REACHABLE, which is a wider surface than the batch-25 'LAN/insider-scoped' framing implied: roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml:58 sets traefik_auth_modes.vaultwarden='oidc', i.e. native_oidc with NO forward-auth middleware on the router, and state/manifest.yml:435 gives vaultwarden both domain_var+port_var so the file provider auto-publishes Host(`pass.<tld>`) on the websecure entryPoint. Anonymous HTTPS therefore reaches the app: the /icons/ SSRF pair needs no session at all, and the WS flood targets the notifications hub which roles/pazny.vaultwarden/templates/compose.yml.j2:23 enables unconditionally (WEBSOCKET_ENABLED: "true"). The 127.0.0.1:8062 host bind (services_lan_access=false) constrains only the DIRECT container port, NOT the Traefik path — Traefik reaches the container over iiab_net/shared_net regardless. Residual mitigations that hold the rating at MEDIUM rather than HIGH: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false, no internet exposure unless the tenant TLD is publicly routed, the org-scoped legs (cross-org cipher/secret access, import authz, Manager enumeration) are all AUTHENTICATED and Tier-3-gated behind Authentik SSO, and the WS leg is availability-only. Cycle-16 batch-35 SCAN (2026-07-27, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NEW, and it OVERTURNS the 2026-07-12 (batch-26) 'gitea NOW CLEAN -- REM-099 RESOLVED, 1.26.4 is still the latest Gitea release and is CVE-clean' disposition. Gitea 1.27.0 was published 2026-07-13T17:07:36Z -- ~37 hours AFTER batch-26 ran (2026-07-12T04:02:42+02:00) -- so the release did not exist at the prior scan. The accompanying 2026-07-13 advisory wave is the LARGEST in Gitea's history: an OSV version-aware query for code.gitea.io/gitea@1.26.4 returns 37 vulnerabilities, 36 of which carry fixed:1.27.0. There is NO 1.26.5 and no 1.27.1 -- the go-gitea/gitea releases API lists v1.27.0 as the newest tag, and EVERY advisory in the wave names 1.27.0 as the SOLE patched version. The 1.26 line received no backport, so the pinned gitea_version 1.26.4 (default.config.yml:1374 + roles/pazny.gitea/defaults/main.yml:10, in sync) sits at the top of every affected range. TWO CRITICALS: (1) CVE-2026-58443 (GHSA-xxjv-752h-3vp2, CVSS 9.6) -- a public-only,write:repository token can update PRIVATE pull-request head branches, because the public-only restriction is checked only against the ROUTE repository (the public base) and not against the private head repo receiving the push; PoC exploit code is publicly disclosed (securityonline.info). (2) CVE-2026-56750 (GHSA-rgv6-xp99-6mgj, CVSS 9.1) -- Remember-Me token theft does not invalidate the attacker's session: on a token-hash mismatch Gitea deletes only the VICTIM's cookie and leaves the attacker's DB session intact, defeating the split-token model and granting indefinite persistent account access. UNAUTHENTICATED HEADLINE (this batch's probe focus): CVE-2026-58436 (GHSA-fw57-jgch-pgf3, HIGH CVSS 8.7) -- the Locale middleware runs in front of EVERY unauthenticated request and calls golang.org/x/text language.ParseAcceptLanguage on the raw Accept-Language header with no size/shape filter. The CVE-2022-32149 guard added in x/text v0.3.8 caps '-' separators at 1000 but NOT '_', even though the parser's scanner aliases '_' to '-' before parsing -- so an underscore-built header re-enters the quadratic path. One unauthenticated GET pins one CPU core for ~2s per 1 MiB of header; ten concurrent clients saturate a ten-core host for ~1 MiB/request of upstream bandwidth, and the endpoint returns 200 OK so the attack does NOT surface on 4xx/5xx dashboards. Affects 1.22.6 through 1.26.x, fixed 1.27.0. OTHER HIGH (all fixed 1.27.0): CVE-2026-56755 (O(N^2) string concat in Debian package upload -> CPU+memory exhaustion DoS), CVE-2026-55987 (OAuth2 sign-in REACTIVATES an administrator-deactivated account on auth sources without refresh tokens -- directly relevant, nOS uses Authentik OIDC as gitea's native_oidc source), CVE-2026-56654 (access-token scope escalation in API), CVE-2026-58314 (two SSRF), CVE-2026-57894 (repo migration follows git HTTP redirects AFTER allow/block validation -> internal-git exfil), CVE-2026-58437 (repository visibility manipulation via git push options), CVE-2026-54481 (internal API HTTP client hardcodes InsecureSkipVerify:true with no config override). Plus ~20 MODERATE (SSRF cluster CVE-2026-59765/58442/58441, PAT/public-only scope bypasses CVE-2026-58444/58429/56443/50105, private-repo existence disclosure via go-get meta CVE-2026-58507, OIDC userinfo returns identity claims without token-scope enforcement CVE-2026-55982, revoked-user private-object reads CVE-2026-59766 sibling of CVE-2026-20800, SSH key parser DoS CVE-2026-56657, NPM tag endpoint unbounded io.ReadAll DoS CVE-2026-42931) and ~5 LOW. SEPARATE PRE-EXISTING: GHSA-263q-5cv3-xq9g / CVE-2025-68939 (HIGH, forbidden-extension release attachments) still lists NO fixed version in OSV; 1.27.0 fixes the web-form VARIANT (CVE-2026-58428) but the parent record remains open upstream -- not closable by this bump, tracked here for lineage only. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan) -- CVE-2026-58436 IS a genuine pre-auth exposure and is EDGE-REACHABLE: traefik_auth_modes.gitea='oidc' means native_oidc with NO forward-auth middleware, so the router answers 200 at the edge and Gitea owns its own login; the Locale middleware fires on the anonymous landing and sign-in pages, i.e. before any credential is presented. The 127.0.0.1:3003 loopback host-bind gates only the direct container port, not the Traefik path. Availability-only impact (no data disclosure), which is why the item is filed CRITICAL on the CVE-2026-58443/56750 legs rather than on the DoS. The two CRITICALs are both AUTHENTICATED (58443 needs a valid public-only write token; 56750 needs a prior remember-me token theft), and signup is external-only per the SSO doctrine (roles/pazny.gitea disables local registration), which bounds the token-holder population to SSO-provisioned users. Cycle-16 batch-35 SCAN (2026-07-27, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NEW, and it OVERTURNS the batch-26 (2026-07-12) recommendation 'bump 0.8.12 -> 0.9.6': the pin DID advance to 0.9.6 (REM-101 correctly closed as resolved), but 0.9.6 (PyPI 2026-06-01) was itself superseded eight days later. Open WebUI 0.10.0 shipped 2026-06-29 and 0.10.2 (latest) on 2026-07-01 carrying an explicit 'Security Advisory ... update production deployments at your earliest convenience' banner. An OSV version-aware query for PyPI open-webui@0.9.6 returns 18 vulnerabilities, ALL of them fixed:0.10.0, disclosed as a coordinated wave on 2026-06-29 / 2026-07-02. The pinned openwebui_version 0.9.6 (default.config.yml:1532 + roles/pazny.open_webui/defaults/main.yml:13, in sync) is the LAST AFFECTED version on every one of them. SIX HIGH: CVE-2026-59214 (GHSA-4r2p-27mh-5m22, stored web-worker XSS via Pyodide), CVE-2026-59216 (GHSA-74h3-cxq7-vc5q, CVSS 7.7 -- an authenticated LOW-PRIVILEGE user executes arbitrary code-interpreter Python and tools INSIDE ANOTHER USER'S authenticated session, via an unvalidated Socket.IO event-caller session_id; this is the most severe leg), CVE-2026-59219 (GHSA-855v-hq7w-jmjw, CVSS 7.1 -- realtime endpoints accept Redis-revoked JWTs after sign-out / OIDC back-channel logout, so a stolen token keeps authenticating new Socket.IO/websocket connections even though HTTP endpoints correctly 401; Redis-configured deployments only, which nOS IS), CVE-2026-59221 (GHSA-frvj-c5qp-xj4w, CVSS 7.7 -- terminal-proxy path-traversal guard bypass: _sanitize_proxy_path() decodes only 8 times, so a 9x percent-encoded '../admin/system' passes validation still-encoded and the upstream terminal server decodes it, forwarding terminal credentials outside the intended path), CVE-2026-59224 (GHSA-j657-m4c4-24jq -- terminal proxy forwards a SPOOFABLE, integrity-unbound user identity (X-... header) to the upstream), CVE-2026-59714 (GHSA-x2ff-v5v8-m75m -- cross-channel message overwrite via the chat-completion API). EIGHT MODERATE: CVE-2026-59212 (model meta.knowledge read-only file access upgradable to file WRITE/DELETE), CVE-2026-59217 (upload metadata.knowledge_id bypasses the knowledge-base write-access check), CVE-2026-59218 (account enumeration via observable login-timing discrepancy), CVE-2026-59220 (ReDoS in skill-mention regexes -> WHOLE-INSTANCE DoS on the DEFAULT config), CVE-2026-59222 (/api/v1/channels/{id}/members exposes the full user model INCLUDING sensitive credentials), CVE-2026-59223 (WEB_FETCH_FILTER_LIST host allow/block bypassable via URL path and non-label-boundary matching), CVE-2026-59225 (arena task endpoints bypass model access controls), CVE-2026-59227 (POST /api/v1/images/edit bypasses the global image-edit switch and per-user image-gen permission). FOUR LOW: CVE-2026-59213 (cross-user model-list exposure via a static aiocache key), CVE-2026-59215 (private channel messages disclosed through cross-channel thread parent_id binding), CVE-2026-59226 (scheduled automations keep running after pending-user deactivation and stored-model ACL revocation), CVE-2026-59715 (see probe). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan) -- ONE genuine unauth leg, and it is the first Open WebUI unauth finding since the N/A LDAP CRITICAL: CVE-2026-59715 (GHSA-gmfw-g93r-vg53, LOW CVSS 3.1, affects >=0.6.16 <0.10.0) -- the Socket.IO server is configured always_connect=True and two Ydoc collaborative-document handlers (ydoc:awareness:update, ydoc:document:leave) perform NO authentication check at all, so an UNAUTHENTICATED client can open a websocket, spoof any user's presence/cursor/selection in collaborative documents, broadcast fake departure events, and hold unlimited unauthenticated connections to exhaust server capacity. Rated LOW upstream (integrity/availability of a collaboration overlay, no data read), and reachable only through the edge route -- traefik_auth_modes.open_webui='oidc' is native_oidc with NO forward-auth middleware, so the router answers 200 anonymously; the 127.0.0.1:3004 loopback bind gates only the direct container port. Every other leg in the wave requires an authenticated session (WEBUI_AUTH=true, Authentik OIDC, local signup disabled per the pure-SSO onboarding doctrine), so the practical exposure is authenticated-insider cross-user compromise -- most acutely CVE-2026-59216 (execute code in another user's session) and CVE-2026-59219 (revoked-token realtime persistence, which directly defeats the OIDC back-channel logout nOS relies on). items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-36 SCAN (2026-07-28, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-093 + REM-116, NOT a re-open: both were correctly RESOLVED on 2026-07-16 when the pin advanced 1.0.0-alpha.93 -> 1.0.0-beta.9 (default.config.yml:1971 + roles/pazny.rustfs/defaults/main.yml:12, in sync; live-verified iiab-rustfs-1 healthy on beta.9). beta.9 cleared the entire June cluster (CVE-2026-55188 / 49991 / 55189 / 55838 + GHSA-7gcx-wg4x-q9x6) and the beta.1 wave. But upstream shipped beta.10 (2026-07-17) and beta.11 (2026-07-23), and TWO advisories published 2026-07-23 -- SEVEN DAYS AFTER the bump landed -- name beta.11 as the sole patched version, so the freshly-bumped beta.9 is again the last-affected release. (1) GHSA-5354-r3w2-34m8 (HIGH, CVSS 3.1 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H, no CVE assigned, affects < 1.0.0-beta.11): the Admin API AddServiceAccount handler verifies the caller holds CreateServiceAccountAdminAction but NEVER validates that the caller may create an account under the SPECIFIED PARENT USER. The parent-user parameter is attacker-controlled, so a limited IAM admin mints a service account whose parent is the ROOT user; at authentication time that account is then granted full owner-level permissions = complete privilege escalation to storage root (CWE-269). (2) GHSA-3ppv-fx5m-m749 (MODERATE, CVSS 3.1 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N, no CVE, affects <= 1.0.0-beta.10): a one-way GetObjectVersion-to-GetObject compatibility mapping in policy evaluation makes RustFS select the NON-versioned s3:GetObject action even when the request carries an explicit versionId, so a principal allowed s3:GetObject but denied s3:GetObjectVersion reads historical object content it must not see; affects direct GetObject, CopyObject source, and UploadPartCopy source. BOTH LEGS ARE AUTHENTICATED -- (1) needs valid credentials carrying CreateServiceAccountAdminAction (an IAM-administrator-grade identity), (2) needs a principal with restricted S3 read policy. NEITHER is anonymously reachable, so this is an insider/credential-compromise escalation item, not an internet-anon one. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): the RustFS attack surface is unchanged and the pre-auth leg stays CLOSED. state/manifest.yml:393 gives rustfs a domain_var + port_var bound to rustfs_console_port, so the Traefik file provider publishes ONLY the console (9001) at the edge -- and traefik_auth_modes['rustfs']='none' (roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml:41, 'S3 API, own credentials') means NO authentik@file forward-auth middleware, i.e. the console answers anonymously and RustFS's own beta-grade login is the only wall. That standing exposure is why the previously-tracked unauth legs mattered; both are now closed at the pin -- GHSA-xp32-gxq2-3v52 (unauthenticated console license-metadata disclosure, <= beta.1, fixed beta.2) and CVE-2026-40937 (REM-093 notification-target webhook config) are BOTH below beta.9. The S3 + admin API (RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET) host-binds 127.0.0.1:9010 loopback only (compose.yml.j2 ports), reachable otherwise solely on iiab_net / shared_net; the FTP frontend and bucket replication stay unconfigured by default. NOTE ON SOURCES: OSV's crates.io index is INCOMPLETE for RustFS -- a package query returns only 13 alpha-era advisories and a version-aware query for 1.0.0-beta.9 returns ZERO, silently missing both this pair and the whole June cluster; the rustfs/rustfs GitHub Security Advisories tab is the authoritative source and was read directly. items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-36 SCAN (2026-07-28, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-103, NOT a re-open: REM-103 was correctly RESOLVED on 2026-07-13 when the pin moved off the EOL floating '8.0' tag (final 8.0.6) onto 8.6.3 (default.config.yml:1140 + roles/pazny.redis/defaults/main.yml:14, in sync), clearing the May-2026 DarkReplica cluster (CVE-2026-23479 / 25243 / 25588 / 25589 / 23631) that had NO 8.0.x backport. Since then upstream published 8.6.4 (2026-06-04) and 8.6.5 (2026-07-23). Redis 8.6.5 carries the release-notes tag 'Upgrade Urgency: SECURITY' -- Redis's highest -- and fixes TWO RCE-class memory-corruption bugs absent from the pinned 8.6.3, shipped as a coordinated multi-branch wave (8.8.1 / 8.6.5 / 8.4.5 / 8.2.8 / 7.4.10 / 7.2.15 / 6.2.23, all published within ~90 minutes on 2026-07-23). (1) CORE, APPLIES: a malicious stream RESTORE payload can make two consumers point at the SAME pending-entry NACK record, so removing both consumers frees the same object twice -- a use-after-free / double-free potentially enabling remote code execution. This is in core Streams, present in the stock redis image. (2) P1046, N/A BY CONFIG: crafted RESTORE payloads in the RedisBloom and TDigest modules trigger out-of-bounds writes, potentially leading to RCE -- the stock redis:8.6.x image loads NO modules (compose.yml.j2 command is redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --requirepass ..., no --loadmodule), exactly the same N/A-by-config disposition that retired CVE-2026-25588/25589 in REM-103. NO CVE IDs assigned yet and Redis's own 8.6.5 notes carry no CVSS -- confidence HIGH on existence (verbatim upstream release notes, security urgency tag, coordinated 7-branch wave), MEDIUM on precise severity scoring. Filed HIGH for consistency with REM-103, whose CVE-2026-23479/25243 are the same authenticated-RESTORE/UAF-to-RCE class scored 7.7 by Redis. MITIGATED, exactly as REM-103 was: RESTORE is a normal command requiring an AUTHENTICATED connection, and the deployment binds 127.0.0.1:{{ redis_port|6379 }} loopback only (compose.yml.j2 ports) with --requirepass set unconditionally (REM-003/REM-012) plus infra_net / shared_net / gated_b2b_net internal reachability; there is no HTTP surface and no LAN bind unless services_lan_access=true. So the practical attacker is an already-authenticated client or a compromised in-stack service (authentik, outline, superset, erpnext, firefly), not an anonymous remote. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): pre-auth network surface remains NIL -- no HTTP/edge endpoint, no Traefik router (no domain_var in state/manifest.yml), loopback-only host bind, password required before any command including RESTORE. Cycle-16 batch-36 SCAN (2026-07-28, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NOT a CVE -- currency/hygiene item, filed so a Tier-1 secrets vault's pin does not silently rot (same class as REM-135 spacetimedb, but on a DEFAULT-ON component). The CVE leg is CLEAN and re-confirmed for the fourth consecutive batch: the Infisical/infisical GitHub Security Advisories endpoint returns an EMPTY list (zero advisories ever published), and prior batches cleared OSV.dev, the GitHub Advisory DB and NVD (keywordSearch=infisical, totalResults 0). The 2026 search near-hits remain OTHER vendors (Tenda router CVE-2026-4041, Gardyn IoT CVE-2026-54477) and, this batch, a large volume of n8n RCE coverage (CVE-2026-21858 / 21877) that is a different product entirely. WHAT CHANGED: the pinned infisical_version v0.160.4 (default.config.yml:2610 + roles/pazny.infisical/defaults/main.yml:10, in sync, shadow already cleared) now trails upstream by two minor lines -- latest is v0.162.14 (2026-07-27), with releases landing near-daily (v0.162.5 through v0.162.14 all shipped 2026-07-13..27). No release in that span is flagged as a security fix and no GHSA backs any of them, so severity is LOW and confidence on 'no known vulnerability' is HIGH. STANDING CAVEAT, unchanged and the reason this is tracked at all: Infisical uses PRIVATE disclosure (security@infisical.com + Cure53 engagements) and publishes no advisories, so a fixed-but-unadvised issue can ship silently inside an ordinary release -- for this vendor, version currency IS the security control, because there will never be a CVE to trigger a bump. That asymmetry is what lifts this above pure hygiene: unlike spacetimedb (install=false), install_infisical=true by DEFAULT and Infisical is the Tier-1 central secrets vault holding infra credentials, so an unadvised fix left unapplied has real blast radius. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): NO unauth exposure, re-verified. The vault is gated at the edge by authentik@file forward-auth (traefik_auth_modes.infisical='proxy', roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml:75 -- deliberately a proxy gate rather than native OIDC because CE org-OIDC is enterprise-licensed and inert on CE), and the container host-binds 127.0.0.1:{{ infisical_port|8075 }}:8080 loopback only (compose.yml.j2:16). /api/status is the intentionally-public health endpoint and is the manifest's health_check target (state/manifest.yml:124). Cycle-16 batch-37 SCAN (2026-07-29, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). SUCCESSOR to REM-118 (resolved), not a re-open: the pin correctly advanced php8.3-1.17.159 -> 2.1.3-php8.3 and closed the CVE-2026-53595 CRITICAL 9.4 unauth account-takeover leg. But nfrastack 2.1.3-php8.3 (image published 2026-06-27) bundles FreeScout app 1.8.226, and upstream has since shipped FIVE app releases, THREE of which are explicitly security releases: 1.8.227 (2026-07-04, GHSA-v8vc-cmf9-gg2c + dependency library patches), 1.8.230 (2026-07-18, 'Improved remote URL sanitizing' GHSA-6w8v-qp43-vg2h + 'Send CSP header in /ajax-html/ URLs' GHSA-2g42-f97q-973x), 1.8.231 (2026-07-25, 'Check customer visibility in load_customer_info ajax action' GHSA-cr68-27qv-p5m4 + 'Restricted access to Assigned Conversations option in user profiles' GHSA-m4hc-rc98-38jc + 'Change customer when received a reply to a conversation from completely new email address' GHSA-j49f-9g94-3wh4 + 'Tighten throttling in Forgot Password requests' GHSA-jvmv-2qcp-7855). KEY EVIDENCE / WHY THIS IS FILED AT MEDIUM WITH MEDIUM CONFIDENCE ON SEVERITY: six of those seven GHSA IDs are UNPUBLISHED in the GitHub global advisory database -- `gh api advisories/<id>` returns 404 for GHSA-v8vc-cmf9-gg2c, GHSA-6w8v-qp43-vg2h, GHSA-2g42-f97q-973x, GHSA-cr68-27qv-p5m4, GHSA-m4hc-rc98-38jc and GHSA-j49f-9g94-3wh4, and none appears in the repo's 93 published advisories. So these are REAL security fixes shipped in tagged releases with NO public CVSS, NO CVE and NO affected-range metadata. A version-keyed scanner sees nothing; only the release-note prose reveals them. Confidence HIGH on the version-lag fact (release notes are authoritative), MEDIUM on severity (no published vector to score). The only one that IS published, GHSA-jvmv-2qcp-7855 / CVE-2026-45294 (MODERATE 5.3, unauth agent-email enumeration via password-reset response differentiation), is patched at 1.8.219 and therefore ALREADY covered by the pin -- 1.8.231 merely tightens the throttling further. RE-VERIFIED COVERED (no action): the entire 2026-07-15 published advisory batch is patched at <=1.8.226 and so is already closed by the pin -- GHSA-gh3r-jh6q-wrvj / CVE-2026-62856 (HIGH 7.7, cross-user notification disclosure via LIKE-wildcard injection in the polycast channel query; notable because the polycast routes lack the auth middleware, so any visitor holding a session+CSRF token reaches it), GHSA-jpq8-j69f-mj98 / CVE-2026-62854 (HIGH 7.6, stored XSS in mailbox signature via same-origin JS upload), GHSA-w668-wq26-6c94 / CVE-2026-62852 (MED 6.5), GHSA-wqq7-4q7m-273v / CVE-2026-62851 (MED 4.3), GHSA-62855 path traversal + GHSA-w2p9 tools.php (both <=1.8.225). PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): traefik_auth_modes.freescout='oidc' -> native OIDC, 200 at edge, FreeScout owns its login page and is NOT forward-auth gated; install_freescout=true (default-on, b2b stack); 127.0.0.1:8090 loopback host-bind (services_lan_access=false) blocks the direct port but NOT the Traefik route. Probe-relevant residual among the unpublished set: GHSA-j49f-9g94-3wh4 rebinds a conversation's customer when a reply arrives from a completely new email address -- inbound email is an UNAUTHENTICATED input channel and this is the same class as the previously-patched CVE-2026-53591 thread-injection leg, so it is the most likely pre-auth item in the batch (unconfirmed: advisory unpublished). ACTION: bump freescout_version '2.1.3-php8.3' -> '2.1.5-php8.3' in BOTH default.config.yml:2008 AND roles/pazny.freescout/defaults/main.yml:9 (version-pin-shadow rule -- default.config.yml wins at runtime). 2.1.5-php8.3 (2026-07-18) is a DROP-IN: same nfrastack 2.1.x image scheme, same php8.3 variant, linux/arm64 present, bundles app 1.8.230 -> clears GHSA-v8vc-cmf9-gg2c + GHSA-6w8v-qp43-vg2h + GHSA-2g42-f97q-973x. CAVEAT ON GOING FURTHER: app 1.8.231 (the load_customer_info / assigned-conversations / customer-rebind trio) is only in image 2.2.1, and the 2.2.x line publishes NO php8.3 variant -- only php8.5 tags exist (2.2.1-php8.5, 2.2.1-alpine, latest). Moving to 2.2.1 is therefore a PHP 8.3 -> 8.5 major-minor runtime jump on top of the app bump, the same class of image-rescheme risk as the php8.3-1.17.x -> 2.x.x move that REM-118 navigated. Recommend the 2.1.5-php8.3 drop-in now and a separately-verified 2.2.1 move once php8.5 compatibility is exercised (or wait for a 2.2.x php8.3 tag). REM-029/069/070/071/118 all remain resolved. RECONCILED 2026-08-01: the pin was applied and the LIVE container runs nfrastack/freescout:2.1.5-php8.3 (verified against `docker ps`, not against the pin). The queue had carried it as pending because nothing re-derives status from the running estate after a converge.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-16 batch-37 SCAN (2026-07-29, unauthenticated_endpoint_scan). NOT a CVE -- supply-chain reproducibility + currency item that PROMOTES the standing 'repin off the floating feature-SHA to a tagged release' recommendation (carried as prose in scan-state since 2026-07-02) into a tracked queue entry, because the blocker that justified the SHA has now been disproven. The in-repo comments at default.config.yml:2206 ('ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip (no semver tags published)') and roles/pazny.paperclip/defaults/main.yml:11 ('upstream publishes only latest (no fixed/semver tags)') are FACTUALLY STALE: `gh api repos/paperclipai/paperclip/releases` returns dated release tags -- v2026.722.0 (2026-07-22), v2026.720.0, v2026.707.0, v2026.626.0, v2026.618.0, v2026.609.0 -- i.e. the same v2026.MMDD.0 scheme as the v2026.416.0 fix release the pin is already described against. The pinned sha-b9a80dc is a 2026-04-17 commit, so the pin now trails upstream by roughly three months and six releases while remaining a mutable, non-reproducible feature-SHA reference. CVE LEG: no NEW published-and-applicable advisory -- every item on the paperclipai/paperclip advisories page with a patched version is fixed at v2026.416.0 and therefore already covered by the pinned descendant commit (CVE-2026-41679 CRIT unauth import-authz RCE, CVE-2026-41208 HIGH provisionCommand injection, GHSA-vr7g-88fq-vhq3 CRIT cleanupCommand OS-command-injection, GHSA-3xx2-mqjm-hg9x + GHSA-47wq-cj9q-wpmp CRIT cross-tenant agent-key IDOR/minting, GHSA-xfqj-r5qw-8g4j HIGH unauth access to multiple API endpoints in authenticated mode, GHSA-w8hx-hqjv-vjcq, GHSA-p7mm-r948-4q3q, GHSA-fpw4-p57j-hqmq, GHSA-3pw3-v88x-xj24). THE ONE NEW ADVISORY THIS BATCH IS **N/A BY VERIFIED CONFIGURATION** -- see the vuln-report entry: GHSA-x8hx-rhr2-9rf7 (CRITICAL, CVSS 9.6 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H, CWE-862 + CWE-1188, published 2026-07-22, range '<0.3.1', patched_versions field EMPTY = unpatched at publication) -- drive-by unauthenticated RCE against LOCAL Paperclip instances via DNS rebinding, and it explicitly defeats a 127.0.0.1 bind. nOS is NOT affected, verified by reading the pinned commit's own source rather than inferring from the advisory prose: (1) roles/pazny.paperclip/templates/compose.yml.j2:32 sets PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE='authenticated', and server/src/middleware/auth.ts@b9a80dc line 25 scopes the auto-admin actor ({isInstanceAdmin:true, source:'local_implicit'}) to deploymentMode==='local_trusted' ONLY -- in authenticated mode a rebound request arrives as actor {type:'none'}; (2) server/src/config.ts@b9a80dc line 179 defaults deploymentExposure to 'private' when PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE is unset (nOS does not set it), and server/src/app.ts@b9a80dc lines 96-97 enable the private-hostname guard when exposure==='private' && (local_trusted||authenticated) -- so the Host-header guard IS ACTIVE on the pinned build; (3) the guard (server/src/middleware/private-hostname-guard.ts@b9a80dc) reads x-forwarded-host then host, and 403s any hostname outside {localhost,127.0.0.1,::1} + the registered allowlist, which roles/pazny.paperclip/tasks/post.yml:65-84 populates NARROWLY via `pnpm paperclipai allowed-hostname {{ paperclip_domain }}` plus service_extra_hosts -- an attacker's rebinding domain is not on it. Two independent controls, both source-verified at the pinned SHA. NO ACTION IS REQUIRED FOR THE CRITICAL; this item is the currency leg only. FORWARD RISK THIS BOUNDS: the guard is the sole structural defense against the rebinding class, and it is silently disabled by setting PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE to a non-'private' value -- treat that env var as security-relevant and never introduce it as a route-debugging workaround; the correct fix for a blocked hostname is to register it via the post.yml allowlist task. PROBE (unauthenticated_endpoint_scan): traefik_auth_modes.paperclip='proxy' (authentik@file forward-auth gate) + 127.0.0.1:3006 loopback host-bind (services_lan_access=false) + the active hostname guard -> not anonymously reachable at the edge, and now demonstrably not reachable via the browser-mediated rebinding path either. ACTION: repin paperclip_version 'sha-b9a80dc' -> 'v2026.722.0' in default.config.yml:2206 AND roles/pazny.paperclip/defaults/main.yml:11, and correct the stale 'no semver tags published' comments in both files. auto_fixable=false: this is a three-month code advance on an agent-orchestration service with a Postgres schema, so it needs a supervised converge (DB migration + the post.yml CEO-bootstrap and allowed-hostname re-registration path) rather than a mechanical tag swap. Same reproducibility class as REM-141 infisical / REM-135 spacetimedb.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-17 batch-38 SCAN (2026-07-30, version_header_leakage). LIVE-CONFIRMED, NOT theoretical -- this is the probe's finding of record and it OVERTURNS the standing 'dashboard + api.insecure bound 127.0.0.1:8080 loopback' disposition that has been carried in scan-state for traefik since batch-21. The loopback bind is real but IRRELEVANT: state/manifest.yml:145-153 gives the traefik entry BOTH domain_var (traefik_domain) and port_var (traefik_dashboard_port), so roles/pazny.traefik/templates/dynamic/services.yml.j2 auto-derives a file-provider router for it -- and roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml sets traefik_auth_modes.traefik='none' with the now-FALSE inline comment "own dashboard (LAN-only via 127.0.0.1 bind)". Router as rendered live (GET /api/rawdata): {"traefik@file": entryPoints:[websecure], rule: Host(`traefik.<tld>`), middlewares: [security-headers@file, compress@file], service -> http://192.168.65.254:8082}. There is NO authentik@file in that middleware chain, and the backend URL is the Docker host-gateway address -- i.e. Traefik itself proxies AROUND the 127.0.0.1 bind it was supposed to be protected by. Combined with api.insecure:true + api.dashboard:true in roles/pazny.traefik/templates/traefik.yml.j2, the ENTIRE Traefik API is anonymous over HTTPS:443. LIVE EVIDENCE (unauthenticated GET, Host header only, no cookie/token): /api/version -> 200 {"Version":"3.6.23","Codename":"ramequin"}; /dashboard/ -> 200; /api/overview -> 200 (54 routers / 52 services / 13 middlewares); /api/rawdata -> 200, 35670 bytes = the complete edge topology (every router rule, every internal backend URL and port, every middleware); /api/http/middlewares -> 200, 4971 bytes. THE CRITICAL LEG IS SECRET DISCLOSURE, not version disclosure. /api/http/middlewares serves the rendered `headers.customRequestHeaders` maps VERBATIM, which means the two SEC-6 edge-trust tokens are readable by any anonymous client: (1) face-edge@file -> X-Face-Edge-Token: '<prefix>_pw_face_edge'; (2) wing-edge@file -> X-Wing-Edge-Token: '<64-hex>'. Both tokens exist SOLELY on the premise, documented in middlewares.yml.j2 itself, that 'only Traefik (which holds the token) can present it' and that customRequestHeaders REPLACES any client-sent value so 'a peer on gated_net cannot pre-poison it'. That premise is now false at the FRONT of the proxy rather than behind it. Consequences: X-Face-Edge-Token is the exact condition under which the nOS face BFF (files/anatomy/face, src/hooks.server.ts) TRUSTS attacker-supplied X-Authentik-* identity headers -> forge the pair and impersonate any user including nos-admins; X-Wing-Edge-Token defeats Wing's BasePresenter::startup() edge gate, the second half of the SEC-6 defense-in-depth pair whose first half (the 127.0.0.1 Caddyfile bind) is likewise bypassable via a Traefik route. WORST LEG -- PREFIX DISCLOSURE: default.credentials.yml:421 defines face_edge_token as the literal template '{{ global_password_prefix }}_pw_face_edge', so the leaked header value discloses global_password_prefix IN CLEARTEXT (live host: the prefix was recovered verbatim from the anonymous response). That single string is the seed for EVERY unset credential in default.credentials.yml -- the whole '{global_password_prefix}_pw_{service}' family -- so an anonymous reader can DERIVE, without further interaction, any service password the operator did not explicitly override: woodpecker_agent_secret, the DB passwords, mysqld_exporter_password, akadmin_password, the authentik_oidc_*_client_secret seed twins, etc. This converts an information-disclosure bug into a full credential-derivation compromise of the tenant. REACHABILITY (stated honestly, do not overclaim): CONFIRMED anonymous over HTTPS from the LAN/Tailscale surface -- Traefik binds 0.0.0.0:443 and the only precondition is the ability to reach the host on 443 and set the Host header. The hostname IS publicly resolvable (dig @1.1.1.1 traefik.<tld> -> Cloudflare 188.114.96.9/97.9), but INTERNET reachability could NOT be verified from inside the LAN: split-horizon DNS (dnsmasq) resolves the name to the host's own LAN address, so the 'public' curl in this batch provably transited the LAN (remote_ip was the 192.168.x host), NOT the Cloudflare edge. Whether CF proxies through to this origin is UNVERIFIED and must be checked from an off-net vantage point before rating internet exposure. ACTION (any one closes the anonymous leg; do at least the first): (1) set traefik_auth_modes.traefik: 'proxy' in roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml so authentik@file gates the router -- note this is a Tier-1 admin surface and 'none' was never a defensible mode for it; or add 'traefik' to traefik_skip_ids so no edge router is derived at all. (2) Set api.insecure:false in traefik.yml.j2 (the dashboard then requires an explicit secured router) -- defense in depth even after (1). (3) INDEPENDENT of the routing fix, treat the exposed values as BURNED: rotate global_password_prefix, wing_edge_token and face_edge_token, and stop deriving edge tokens from the prefix -- default.credentials.yml:420-421 already carry an 'openssl rand -hex 32' comment that wing_edge_token honours (it rendered as 64-hex) and face_edge_token does NOT (it rendered as the prefix template). Making face_edge_token an independently-generated secret removes the prefix-disclosure leg even if a header is leaked again. (4) Consider a repo gate asserting that no manifest entry with a domain_var maps to traefik_auth_modes 'none' unless explicitly allowlisted -- the root cause is that 'none' silently means 'anonymous at the edge', the same general lesson batch-34 recorded for native_oidc services.

SECRET LEG: face_edge_token joined the main.yml regeneration group AND templates/secrets.yml.j2 persistence (it was in neither — its sibling wing_edge_token was in both), so it is a 256-bit random persisted secret instead of {prefix}_pw_face_edge; the global password prefix is no longer on the edge surface. items.resolved_detail: LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-08-04 (the record carried a bare status+date until then, with no resolved_by and no evidence — which is how a reader on 2026-08-04 reported this CRITICAL as still open). items.remediation_detail: Cycle-17 batch-38 SCAN (2026-07-30, version_header_leakage). NEW advisory published 2026-07-27T09:02:31Z -- i.e. AFTER the last traefik look (batch-28, 2026-07-15) and after the v3.6.23 pin that REM-127 landed. GHSA-3ccp-42pg-hgv6, 'Cross-user response poisoning via proxied CONNECT on Traefik's shared backend keep-alive pool'. NO CVE ID assigned yet. CVSS 4.0 = 7.0 HIGH, vector CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:H/SA:N, CWE-444 (HTTP request/response smuggling). Affected: v2.x <= 2.11.52 (fix 2.11.53), v3.6 <= 3.6.23 (fix 3.6.24), v3.7 <= 3.7.8 (fix 3.7.9); all three fix releases shipped 2026-07-24. The pinned traefik_image_version v3.6.23 (default.config.yml:1869 + roles/pazny.traefik/defaults/main.yml:16, in sync) is the TOP of the v3.6 affected range. MECHANISM: Traefik's default httputil.ReverseProxy forwards a client CONNECT request -- with a live body stream -- to an HTTP/1.1 upstream instead of rejecting it. If that upstream answers a keep-alive NON-2xx without draining the request body, the now-desynchronised backend socket is returned to Traefik's SHARED connection pool; the next client to draw that socket receives responses queued from the attacker's smuggled requests. Impact is unauthenticated cross-user response poisoning -- one user is served another user's response, potentially authenticated/private content -- and with a bounded pool a single desync can poison a whole response queue, hitting multiple victims. APPLICABILITY TO nOS = YES, both preconditions are met and were verified live this batch, not assumed. (1) FRONTEND must be HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 (HTTP/1.1 frontends are unaffected): every edge probe in this batch negotiated h2 over the websecure entrypoint -- responses came back as literal 'HTTP/2 200' -- because traefik.yml.j2 terminates TLS on websecure and Go's server offers h2 via ALPN by default. (2) BACKEND must answer a keep-alive non-2xx without draining; the advisory explicitly names Go net/http and gunicorn/Flask upstreams as remaining exploitable, and nOS's Tier-1 upstream fleet is full of both -- woodpecker-server is Go net/http, calibre-web is Flask/Werkzeug (live-confirmed this batch: '302 FOUND' with Werkzeug-style uppercase reason phrase), plus the Python/uvicorn and Node/Express services behind the same edge. The advisory notes the default sanitizePath option is only an INCOMPLETE mitigation. Not provider-specific (not a Kubernetes-only item, unlike most of the recent traefik advisory wave). ACTION: bump v3.6.23 -> v3.6.24 in default.config.yml:1869 AND roles/pazny.traefik/defaults/main.yml:16 together (version-pin-shadow discipline). Patch-level move within the 3.6 line, no config change. Documented risk-reducers if the bump must be deferred: maxIdleConnsPerHost:-1 to disable backend pooling, or the experimental FastProxy implementation. ALSO SURFACED THIS BATCH, N/A: GHSA-8rxv-jg7p-wvg3 (HIGH, 2026-07-16, Kubernetes Ingress NGINX RewriteTarget path-traversal route-level auth bypass) -- Kubernetes Ingress-NGINX provider ONLY, and nOS runs the Docker + file providers with no K8s provider configured. REM-127 stays RESOLVED (its v3.6.21 -> v3.6.23 bump landed and is live: the running container is traefik:v3.6.23 and /api/version self-reports 3.6.23).
items.resolution: Pin ADVANCED to the fixed release. default.config.yml:1869 and roles/pazny.traefik/defaults/main.yml:16 both read traefik_image_version: "v3.6.24" (v3.6.23 was the top of the affected v3.6 range). Bumped in the same change as REM-144 since both land on one container recreate.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-17 batch-38 SCAN (2026-07-30, version_header_leakage). CVE LEG IS CLEAN -- an OSV version-aware query for go.woodpecker-ci.org/woodpecker/v3@3.14.1 returns exactly 2 entries and they are the same finding twice (GHSA-qf34-295c-26v8 = GO-2026-5992 = CVE-2026-61549, HIGH, unrestricted serviceAccountName pipeline-pod privilege escalation, affected 1.0.0-3.15.0, fix 3.16.0), which is KUBERNETES-BACKEND-ONLY and therefore N/A: roles/pazny.woodpecker/templates/compose.yml.j2 hard-sets WOODPECKER_BACKEND=docker. Nothing has been published on the repo since that advisory (2026-07-01); the two other titles that surface in a naive web search, GHSA-4gcf-5m39-98mc and GHSA-xw35-rrcp-g7xm, were fetched and are CVE-2023-40034 (fix 1.0.2) and CVE-2024-41121 (fix 2.7.0) -- both years old and both far below the pin. REM-105 and REM-002 stay resolved. PROBE FINDING (version_header_leakage), LIVE-CONFIRMED: Woodpecker's /version endpoint is anonymously readable THROUGH THE TRAEFIK EDGE, not merely on loopback. Unauthenticated GET https://ci.<tld>/version -> HTTP/2 200 {"source":"https://github.com/woodpecker-ci/woodpecker","version":"3.14.1"} and GET / -> 200 serving the SPA shell. No version-bearing RESPONSE HEADER is emitted (no Server, no X-Powered-By -- Go net/http sends none), so the leak is a body-level version oracle rather than a header one. IMPORTANT DISPOSITION CORRECTION: every prior scan-state note for woodpecker (batch-16 and batch-28) recorded the mitigation as 'forward_auth (Authentik gates the route) + Gitea OAuth2 app-auth'. THAT IS WRONG and CLAUDE.md repeats it ('Woodpecker (route gate on top of Gitea-OAuth app-auth)' in the forward_auth bucket). roles/pazny.traefik/vars/main.yml sets traefik_auth_modes.woodpecker='oidc', with an explicit inline rationale -- a forward-auth gate would be the documented double-login anti-pattern AND would 302 the playbook's own Woodpecker API post-wiring -- so there is NO authentik@file middleware on this router and the edge answers anonymously. The live probe confirms it. The 127.0.0.1:8060/:9060 host binds constrain only the direct container ports, never the Traefik path (the same lesson batch-34 recorded for vaultwarden and this batch re-learned, far more expensively, for traefik itself in REM-144). SEVERITY IS LOW and the 'oidc' mode remains the right call: the exposure is precise-version disclosure plus an SPA shell, every API call still 401s, and login still redirects to Gitea OAuth -- no data exposure. It is filed because an exact-version oracle at an internet-facing edge lets an attacker pre-stage the next Woodpecker advisory against a known-vulnerable build with zero noise, and because the RECORDED mitigation was materially false and would have mis-scoped any future finding on this component. install_woodpecker=false by default (though it IS running on the live host). ACTION: (a) correct the woodpecker disposition here and in the CLAUDE.md SSO trichotomy -- it belongs in the native_oidc bucket, not forward_auth; (b) OPTIONAL currency bump v3.14.1 -> v3.16.0 in default.config.yml:1552 + roles/pazny.woodpecker/defaults/main.yml:14, which also moves the pin out of the GHSA-qf34 affected range so version-keyed scanners stop flagging it even though the bug is N/A here; (c) no action available on /version itself -- it is unauthenticated by upstream design and gating it would break the app-auth model.

items.remediation_detail: Cycle-17 batch-38 SCAN (2026-07-30, version_header_leakage). CVE LEG IS CLEAN at the pinned jellyfin_version 10.11.10 (default.config.yml:1602 + roles/pazny.jellyfin/defaults/main.yml:10, in sync). Every advisory on the repo was re-pulled with fix versions this batch and all are at or below the pin: CVE-2026-48793 (GHSA-wwwm-px48-fpvq, HIGH 8.8, unauth FFmpeg arg-injection in the subtitle path) range <10.11.10 patched 10.11.10; CVE-2026-49247 (MED, authed /ClientLog/Document path traversal) patched 10.11.10; CVE-2026-49246 (LOW, MKV attachment filename traversal to RCE) patched 10.11.10; CVE-2026-49220 (MED 5.7, user-management XSS) patched 10.11.9; the April cluster CVE-2026-35031/35032/35033/35034 patched 10.11.7. NOTHING has been published since 2026-06-10. Latest 10.11.x is 10.11.11 (2026-06-06, the regression-fix release for 10.11.7 breakage, no security content); the v12.0 line is at rc3 (2026-07-22) and is PRE-RELEASE -- do not move to it. REM-033/072/119 all stay resolved. PROBE FINDING (version_header_leakage), LIVE-CONFIRMED: Jellyfin is the batch's clearest textbook case, leaking on BOTH channels. (1) RESPONSE HEADER: every response carries 'Server: Kestrel', disclosing the ASP.NET Core stack. (2) BODY: unauthenticated GET https://media.<tld>/System/Info/Public -> HTTP/2 200 returning {"LocalAddress","ServerName","Version":"10.11.10","ProductName","OperatingSystem","Id","StartupWizardCompleted"} -- an exact version oracle plus the container hostname as ServerName plus a stable 32-hex server Id usable as a cross-session tracking identifier. Anonymous, no cookie, no token, straight through the Traefik edge. WHY IT IS ANONYMOUS AT THE EDGE: traefik_auth_modes.jellyfin='oidc' (native SSO via the 9p4 SSO-Auth plugin), so no authentik@file middleware is attached and the router forwards anonymous traffic; /System/Info/Public is unauthenticated by upstream design (clients need it for discovery). AMPLIFIER, unchanged from batch-16/28 and re-confirmed live: jellyfin_lan_access defaults TRUE in BOTH default.config.yml:1603 and the role default, so the container publishes 0.0.0.0:8096 (docker ps live: '0.0.0.0:8096->8096/tcp, [::]:8096->8096/tcp'), not a loopback bind -- this is the ONE service in this batch whose raw port is LAN-reachable independently of Traefik, and the SSO-Auth plugin does not gate that raw port. So the disclosure is reachable by two independent paths. SEVERITY LOW: pure information disclosure, no authentication or integrity impact, and the leg that made this combination genuinely dangerous (CVE-2026-48793, unauth FFmpeg arg-injection on a LAN-reachable port) is PATCHED at the current pin. It is filed rather than dropped because the exact-version oracle is what makes the NEXT unauth Jellyfin advisory instantly targetable on this host, and because install_jellyfin=false is the documented mitigation yet the service is in fact RUNNING on the live host (jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.10) -- the 'default-off' framing should stop being counted as a control for this tenant. ACTION (all optional, none urgent): (a) set jellyfin_lan_access=false unless TV/mobile clients genuinely need the raw port, which removes the second path; (b) if the raw port must stay, accept that /System/Info/Public is un-gateable and treat the version as public -- i.e. keep the pin current aggressively, since disclosure plus lag is the actual risk; (c) 'Server: Kestrel' cannot be removed upstream but a Traefik customResponseHeaders entry setting Server to empty on this router would strip it at the edge -- cosmetic, and it does nothing for the raw-port path.
