--- 2026-08-06 cycle-23 batch-44 (supply_chain_freshness -- FIRST RUN of this probe type; mailpit,nginx,vaultwarden,ollama,spacetimedb): +REM-171 (MEDIUM, mailpit v1.30.5 -> v1.30.6: CVE-2026-67448 / GHSA-8r62-w5wh-fc5m, WebSocket origin-check bypass via percent-encoded path, CVSS 6.5, published 2026-07-28, affects 1.29.0-1.30.5 -- LIVE at the pin, and the FIRST CONFIDENTIALITY leg in a mailpit tail that had been availability-only; it is a REGRESSION of CVE-2026-22689 which this queue closed at 1.28.2, and because mailpit_ui_user defaults to '' the origin check is the ONLY control on the unauthenticated loopback API), +REM-172 (MEDIUM, ollama supply-chain provenance: the running binary is pazny/local/ollama 0.30.7_1 from an operator-authored LOCAL TAP, while the playbook declares only `name: ollama, state: latest` with no tap pin, no version var and no post-install assertion -- so the REM-096 'floats past 0.17.1' disposition is true by accident and unmeasured, and a fresh blank installs a different core-tap binary that cannot serve GGUF), +REM-173 (LOW, spacetimedb v2.7.0-hotfix3 -> v2.8.0, freshness only: security-advisories API empty, OSV empty, and BOTH new release bodies read and confirmed security-free), +REM-174 (LOW, gate coverage: test_image_pin_hygiene.py does not scan roles/pazny.*/templates/compose.yml.j2, where 28 image lines carry a floating `| default('latest')` fallback and mailpit falls back to an ancient v1.20 -- MEASURED as 0/28 reachable today, so LOW, but commit 1bc5dcbb left exactly one declaration per pin, which means a single deletion now silently degrades a service to `latest` through a gate that cannot see it). NO CRITICAL this batch, so the vuln report was not prepended. nginx and vaultwarden closed with NO new item: nginx re-verified against nginx.org's authoritative advisory page -- nothing published after the 2026-07-15 1.31.3/1.30.4 wave, no 1.31.4 exists, REM-134 stands resolved, and install_nginx=false keeps the default install at zero nginx surface; vaultwarden live on 1.37.0 exactly matching the pin with REM-136 resolved, and 1.37.1 (2026-07-29) confirmed a BUGFIX release (invites + an Alpine OpenSSL compile fix), carrying no advisories. THE METHODOLOGICAL LESSON OF THIS BATCH, and it is the mirror of cycle-19/20's 'a GHSA with no CVE id': this probe went looking for stale PINS and found that the sharper risk is stale PROVENANCE. Two of the four findings are cases where a version number was never wrong -- ollama's install is current and mailpit's pin is exact -- but nothing in the repo could prove it: one binary comes from a tap the playbook has never heard of, and one class of pin is defended by a gate that reads the declaration and not the render site. Scanning versions answers 'is the number old'; it does not answer 'is the number load-bearing'. --- 2026-08-05 cycle-22 batch-43 (resource_exhaustion_vectors; firefly,erpnext,homeassistant,onlyoffice,ntfy): +REM-165 (HIGH, erpnext v15.111.0 -> v15.119.0: SEVEN advisories published since the 2026-07-23 'nothing newer than 2026-07-04' call, four of them out-ranging the pin -- GHSA-qpvh-75wh-j645 7.1 unauthorized data modification and GHSA-p577-cxv9-h82f cross-company financial-data read both fix at 15.112.0, CVE-2026-13227 at 15.115.0 -- plus frappe-framework CVE-2026-55852 TarSlip RCE at 15.112.0; the CRITICAL 9.9 SSTI->RCE CVE-2026-65974 fixes at exactly 15.111.0 and was cleared by LUCK, REM-133 having chosen that version seven days before it published), +REM-166 (MEDIUM, firefly version-6.2.21 -> 6.6.3: GHSA-6jq6-x4cx-qvcm ale.twig |raw stored XSS, affected range introduced-0 -> fixed-6.6.3, i.e. the pin was NEVER outside it -- a coverage gap that survived two consecutive 'CLEAN at 6.2.21' scans because the advisory keys on the Packagist name grumpydictator/firefly-iii, not the GitHub path), +REM-167 (MEDIUM, ntfy v2.26.3 -> v2.27.0, released ~24h before this scan: the 32-KB template cap plus printf-width and indent limits are the MEMORY half of the DoS whose CPU half v2.26.0 fixed with a timeout -- a timeout bounds duration, not allocation, and this container has the estate's smallest mem_limit at 512m while being the A9 notification transport), +REM-168 (HIGH, homeassistant, THE PROBE'S FINDING OF RECORD and a pure config defect on a CVE-clean pin: homeassistant@file is anonymous at the edge, HA's validate_login runs a hardcoded cost-12 bcrypt for UNKNOWN usernames as an anti-timing measure, MEASURED at 207.7 ms in-container, and the container is capped at cpus 1.0 -- so ~4.8 anonymous requests/sec from ONE client saturate the whole allocation; the ip_ban_enabled=True that looks like the defence is inert because login_attempts_threshold defaults to -1 and process_wrong_login returns before counting, and nOS sets neither key; second leg = a blocking gethostbyaddr per failed attempt ahead of that early return), +REM-169 (MEDIUM, traefik, the multiplier for the whole batch: ZERO rateLimit and ZERO inFlightReq in the rendered /etc/traefik/conf.d/services.yml inside the running container -- yet keap-ext.yml and keap-ingest.yml each carry one, so the pattern is implemented and working and was applied to 2 of ~30 file-provider routers), +REM-170 (MEDIUM, onlyoffice: the euro-office pilot HAS activated on this host and the standing 'verify its base tag separately' caveat came due -- b2b-onlyoffice-1 runs ghcr.io/euro-office/documentserver:LATEST, dpkg reports euro-office-documentserver 9.3.1-DEV.1, a prerelease BELOW the declared 9.3.1.2 pin every prior CLEAN verdict was issued against; the only OCI label is the Ubuntu base 24.04, so the component cannot be version-scanned at all). METHODOLOGY, a SIXTH consecutive confirmation and the sharpest yet: an OSV version-aware query for frappe/erpnext at 15.111.0 returns ZERO vulns while the vendor's own repo endpoint returns a CRITICAL 9.9 RCE and three out-ranging items, and a direct OSV lookup of that CRITICAL's GHSA returns 'Vulnerability not found'. Three of erpnext's four actionable advisories carry NO CVE at all; ntfy's fix has no CVE, no GHSA and no advisory page; firefly's was missed for two scans over a package-name mismatch. Query the vendor repo endpoint and the release index, not the CVE feed. SECOND METHODOLOGY NOTE, new this batch: version-scan the RUNNING image, not the declared pin. onlyoffice was called CLEAN three times against a pin this host stopped running when the euro-office pilot went live 11 days ago. PROBE (resource_exhaustion_vectors) -- the estate's limits are DECLARED but not LAYERED: every one of the five components sets mem_limit and cpus (ntfy 512m/0.5, firefly + homeassistant 1g/1.0, onlyoffice 2g/1.0, erpnext 1g/1.0 per service) with restart: unless-stopped and capped json-file logging, so a single container cannot exhaust the HOST -- but nothing meters the request stream that fills those caps, so exhausting an individual SERVICE is cheap. ntfy is the one limiter that is correctly wired and it was verified by reading the source rather than assumed: behind-proxy true + ntfy's right-most-address XFF extraction (server/util.go) means Traefik's appended client IP is the one bucketed, so the per-visitor limits are NOT spoofable. Pending CRITICAL unchanged at ZERO; no CRITICAL added this batch, so the vuln report was not prepended.

--- 2026-08-04 cycle-21 batch-42 (tls_crypto_weakness; hedgedoc,gitlab,wordpress,freepbx,bookstack): +REM-158 (LOW, hedgedoc 1.11.0 -> 1.11.1, GHSA-93w7-49m2-cqwg permission-value corruption, released 2026-07-24 = five days AFTER the batch-30 'CLEAN, 1.11.0 is latest' call), +REM-159 (HIGH, gitlab 18.11.7-ce.0 -> 19.2.1-ce.0: the 2026-07-29 patch wave 19.2.1/19.1.3/19.0.5 DROPPED the 18.11 line, which now EOLs ~2026-08-26 -- there will be no 18.11.8, so the pin is terminal and carries CVE-2026-6267 8.5 / CVE-2026-12436 8.4 / CVE-2026-15975 7.5 UNAUTH DoS plus five CE mediums unpatched), +REM-160 (HIGH, wordpress 6.9.4 -> 7.0.2: the wp2shell IMAGE-LAG BLOCK IS LIFTED -- the 7.0.2 tag family landed on Docker Hub 2026-08-02; 6.9.5 was never dockerized; this unblocks REM-129, the actively-exploited unauth-RCE chain), +REM-161 (MEDIUM, bookstack 26.05.2 -> 26.05.3, released 2026-07-29: external-auth ID mismatch on OIDC/SAML2/LDAP is the leg that bites nOS's native-OIDC bookstack, plus login-timing user-enum, file:// export, API debug-detail exposure, PDF-render file access), +REM-162 (LOW, traefik: the 'modern' TLS-1.3-only option is DEAD CONFIG -- every file-provider router resolves to tls.options 'default' because services.yml.j2 emits a bare `tls: {}`; live-confirmed TLS 1.2 handshake at ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256), +REM-163 (MEDIUM, wordpress has no HTTPS-behind-proxy shim, so is_ssl() is false and the post-login auth cookie is issued without Secure; HSTS strongly mitigates), +REM-164 (LOW, tasks/tls-certs.yml chmods the mkcert WILDCARD PRIVATE KEY to 0644 world-readable on the local-TLD path). freepbx: NO new finding -- the FreePBX advisory feed has published nothing since 2026-07-16, and both criticals from that date (GHSA-37j8-fhxx-9vhp UCP socket.io unauth RCE, GHSA-g27h-xf3q-h3rm missedcall unauth SQLi) are already carried by REM-130; vendor-block REM-014/046/113/130 unchanged, install_freepbx=false live. METHODOLOGY, now a FIFTH consecutive confirmation: THREE of the four version findings (hedgedoc, bookstack, and the gitlab line-drop) are invisible to a CVE-keyed scan -- hedgedoc and bookstack shipped security releases with NO CVE or GHSA id, and gitlab's exposure comes not from a new CVE but from a MAINTENANCE-WINDOW change that silently stranded the pinned minor. Scan the vendor's release index and support policy, not the CVE feed. PROBE (tls_crypto_weakness) -- edge posture is SOUND, the defects are declaration-vs-reality: TLS 1.3 negotiates TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS 1.1 is refused, CBC suites are refused at TLS 1.2 (alert 40), HSTS max-age=31536000 includeSubDomains is served on every route, and cert verification is OK. Session-cookie crypto is correct on hedgedoc (Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax), bookstack (Laravel derives secure from APP_URL=https), gitlab (external_url https) -- and wrong only on wordpress (REM-163). Key-derivation checked and MITIGATED: hedgedoc_session_secret and bookstack_app_key look like prefix-derived placeholders in default.credentials.yml but main.yml:1321/1341 replace any value still containing '_pw_' or shorter than the length floor with `openssl rand`, so neither ships as a function of global_password_prefix. Residual, ACCEPTED and pre-existing: every Traefik->service upstream leg is cleartext http:// inside the Docker network (wordpress:80, gitlab:80, bookstack:80, hedgedoc:3000) -- the known SEC-02 flat-shared_net shape, not a new finding. Pending CRITICAL unchanged at TWO (REM-137 gitea, REM-153 metabase); no CRITICAL added this batch, so the vuln report was not prepended.
